body:
Hello! I'm not Tom Cruise ... I am Steven Monahan and I am the only Republican running to take back CD-06. I have no Primary, I have only one opponent - Jason Crow and I can tell you that Jason Crow Has Got To Go. **I have proudly served my country for 20 years. I went from an Enlisted Sailor to a Naval Officer, to a Naval Aviator, and currently serve in the Naval Reserves.** Yesterday, I released my first official campaign advertisement spoofing the hugely popular _Top Gun: Maverick_ trailer. I can be seen riding a motorcycle, talking about woke politicians, and even have drone footage: [](http://link.i-d-pro.com/ls/click?upn=o0B0UmAwDiZB-2F3iBtcXmSGEp84HFF6FT6-2BJcTQTSbrkbGbGNaayJkSiLMt726aT8afreZo3m187FEh-2BZwOH5vw-3D-3DFvb-_XwU9lPq5-2Bze3gI64ohlV0cQwWAuBAU7ADIvj2CS7ymg5B2Xdj8Tkq4QqrzMvs0P4E-2BzAevRj7ufAVqmaqVpRdXzNdnlj84T3nmzqQrfyhZrEgYPkL0WfVp4F-2Bu1NyuwUH3CkAc2Ek2PqfDY1B0c56sXSVJMqWGv3SlPsDL-2FPGFRBlQfpqUCW2g7xUqKA0H3Jsk3xkTok00YwgoCWUBX4etmGOrn-2FNKsBiUsr05GGUreXCHC1IGatAC5O-2B3XUSMx-2BMbvXrXcynr4fXxIR0Yr7DarWPIrCneUUcZDpAnBnmPUv0pAxY7pTPsSnGuLyqss6) I hope that you enjoy our "out of the box" approach to this first ad. This is the first of many ads that we will be sending to present our case to the Unaffiliated voters in CD-06. _Steven Monahan_

name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: Big News that Walz Will Hate
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=1)
---
Peter \-- Got some BIG NEWS! Nothing will make Tim Walz more angry than knowing Action 4 Liberty will be back at the Minnesota State Fair again this year. And guess who's face will be plastered on the top of our booth again?! **It's election year. We're going to be putting our important message about Walz' failures in front of millions of Minnesotans. Fairgoers will hear the truth about Tim Walz' lockdowns, inability to stop Minneapolis from burning or his quest to spend your surplus money on more wasteful government.** And you know we don't shy away from being loud about what we believe in! [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=2) I know what you're probably thinking...you can't believe the State Fair let us back in. After all, who could forget what happened last year. On the first day of the fair I received a call from the front office asking us to remove the King Walz sign from our booth. I politely told them "no, this is free speech." But they insisted because they said the sign was "disrespectful." Glad they could see what we were going for. **Anyways, to my surprise, that night they came to our booth after we left and stole our signs. If you know me, I don't like bullies. So our lawyer drafted up a letter demanding they return, otherwise we'd put up a new sign and charge them for it.** And that's exactly what we did. We put up a new sign and it was a hit! Our booth made a HUGE splash at the state fair. It brought tens of thousands of new people directly into our growing army. And many, many more people saw the message as they passed by. It helped us continue the fight for liberty! This year, we want to make an EVEN BIGGER splash. But I can't do this without your help. I need one of two things to make this year's booth a success: **volunteer** to work a shift or **donate** to help us pay for it. Volunteering at the booth is a ton of fun. We pay for your ticket and give you a free Action 4 Liberty t-shirt. If you would like to work a 6 hour shift between August 25th and Sept 5th, please click the button below and I'll have Bridget reach out to you soon. | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=3 "Volunteer") [Volunteer](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=3)
---
I know not everyone can free up the time to volunteer at the fair. But you can still help tremendously. We need to pay for our handouts, lit pieces, t-shirts, give-aways, and a lot more. I don't know another way your political donations can make this **big of an impact** and reach this many people.
**Please support the Action 4 Liberty booth with a donation today!**
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=4 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=4)
---
Did you see that Walz just happily announced yesterday that the experimental vaccine shot is now available for 6 month old children. It makes you wonder if another pandemic hit and Walz got re-elected, how far he would take his extreme mandates.
That's why voters must be aware of the dangers of Tim Walz.
And re-electing Walz ensures that our surplus money will never be returned to us, despite gas and food prices climbing and family budgets feeling pain. Walz wants more wasteful government spending.
There's simply nothing more important than putting our message in front of millions of Minnesota voters. And the state fair is the best place to do that.
Our enemies will likely do everything they can to derail our message. Who knows, the state fair front office might come after us again.
**BUT WE WON'T BACK DOWN!!!**
_This is a HUGE opportunity It's time we hold Walz accountable and let the voters know his real record. And judging by last year, it will draw in the BIG lines!_
It's time we kick things up to the next level.
**[Help us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_fair_email_2022_v1&n=5) **make our state fair booth successful again.
**Please help us drown out Walz' radical agenda. Let's put our message of liberty in front of the largest crowd in the state.**

After all, who could forget what happened last year. On the first day of the fair I received a call from the front office asking us to remove the King Walz sign from our booth. I politely told them "no, this is free speech." But they insisted because they said the sign was "disrespectful." Glad they could see what we were going for. Anyways, to my surprise, that night they came to our booth after we left and stole our signs. If you know me, I don't like bullies. So our lawyer drafted up a letter demanding they return, otherwise we'd put up a new sign and charge them for it. And that's exactly what we did. We put up a new sign and it was a hit! Our booth made a HUGE splash at the state fair. It brought tens of thousands of new people directly into our growing army. And many, many more people saw the message as they passed by. It helped us continue the fight for liberty! This year, we want to make an EVEN BIGGER splash. But I can't do this without your help. I need one of two things to make this year's booth a success: volunteer to work a shift or donate to help us pay for it. Volunteering at the booth is a ton of fun. We pay for your ticket and give you a free Action 4 Liberty t-shirt. If you would like to work a 6 hour shift between August 25th and Sept 5th, please click the button below and I'll have Bridget reach out to you soon. | "Volunteer" I know not everyone can free up the time to volunteer at the fair. But you can still help tremendously. We need to pay for our handouts, lit pieces, t-shirts, give-aways, and a lot more. I don't know another way your political donations can make this big of an impact and reach this many people. Please support the Action 4 Liberty booth with a donation today! "Donate" Did you see that Walz just happily announced yesterday that the experimental vaccine shot is now available for 6 month old children. It makes you wonder if another pandemic hit and Walz got re-elected, how far he would take his extreme mandates. That's why voters must be aware of the dangers of Tim Walz. And re-electing Walz ensures that our surplus money will never be returned to us, despite gas and food prices climbing and family budgets feeling pain. Walz wants more wasteful government spending. There's simply nothing more important than putting our message in front of millions of Minnesota voters. And the state fair is the best place to do that. Our enemies will likely do everything they can to derail our message. Who knows, the state fair front office might come after us again. BUT WE WON'T BACK DOWN!!! This is a HUGE opportunity It's time we hold Walz accountable and let the voters know his real record. And judging by last year, it will draw in the BIG lines! It's time we kick things up to the next level. make our state fair booth successful again. Please help us drown out Walz' radical agenda. Let's put our message of liberty in front of the largest crowd in the state. In Liberty, ** Jake Duesenberg President, Action 4 Liberty** Action 4 Liberty 1920 Oakcrest Ave #5 Roseville, MN 55113 Action 4 Liberty · United States

name: John Fetterman
subject: Seriously?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This makes me 🙄🙄🙄
#
Derek, this makes me roll my eyes. 🙄🙄
POLITICO just reported that the Mitch McConnell aligned super PAC “Senate Leadership Fund” has already reserved **$24 MILLION** in ads in Pennsylvania.
That’s like, way more than we’ve raised during this entire race. And they're not raising that $25 at a time, day by day. They're just getting giant checks from unnamed, ultra-rich donors.
That really sucks, Derek!
Like, seriously? If you’re Mitch McConnell and you see our campaign’s hard-won grassroots strength, you just ring up your super PAC and pour $24 million into PA, and you can change the stakes of the race???
Derek, I know I’ve asked each + every one of you for a lot lately. It’s expensive to run a campaign like ours. But I’ve never needed support more than right now. We don’t take a cent from corporate super PACs, so it’s up to US to stand up to the GOP’s unlimited dark money.
**Will you make your best donation — maybe even $10 or more — today to help us fight back against the GOP’s super PACs? Here’s the best link to give:**
[**_https://johnfetterman.com/super-pac-fight-back_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47602?refcode=em20220616-6223&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6223%2E434096%2EnyICbz)
I hate how much money is in our politics these days. But in order to win on the issues we care about, I need to be able to respond to the record-shattering hauls of money coming our way.
If you trust me with a donation today, I promise I will fight like hell for you in the U.S. Senate. 🙏
Thank you for sticking by me. It means a lot to be surrounded by so many good people through the good and bad times. I really couldn’t do this without you.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

body:
For your family, for you, for Colorado!

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=e8cd32aa9e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_17_12_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-e8cd32aa9e-584862049

Dear Coloradans,

As we head into the final weeks before the Colorado primary election, it is worth noting the huge win that Mayra Flores just had this week in southern Texas, near the Mexican border, a district where 84% of the population is Hispanic, flipping the district from Blue to Red in seat that had been held by Democrats with few exceptions for a century!

What does this mean for Colorado? 21% of our population is of Hispanic heritage and to win this election against Polis we must garner at least 18% of the Democratic vote. Democratic Hispanics have reached out to our campaign in support of a candidate who will not take their population for granted. With the support of these voters, Greg will become the next governor of Colorado. As a campaign we are extremely excited about this trend that we are seeing throughout our nation, and we are prayerful that this too will happen in our beautiful Colorado.

Greg has spent significant time connecting with Hispanic communities and listening to their concerns. He is ready to address the concerns of all Colorado communities.

The Red Wave is coming to Colorado. It's time to flip Colorado back to the people!

Sincerely,
Lisa Lopez

============================================================
** (http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=e8cd32aa9e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_17_12_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-e8cd32aa9e-584862049)
We are Coloradans who want to freely and responsibly live our best lives. We refuse to be told by so-called experts and politicians how we must live. Together, we can flip the power back to the people by electing a new governor that’s one of us, for all of us. subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqs19qehlhedd6j0ebenla2979le733flj8onko8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5hmaob2cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2ptjc4p6co3keqrr8plke4oj8sbl6prj9odge2oe2dr6ehq7bdhicpi72shmm1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8qmcdb0mmq3fchicoon1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z87de43sk9ni2u6hqsrsff18p08k52i0fauarjm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5hmaob2cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhppnminaeovh52a7m40tr0lch0k1fp8hf0l50cg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5hmaob2cth2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb3p2skq03jkg3n76d791lu32gk9s7bsp23h5cu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5hmaob2cth2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
www.danielsforcongress.org [www.danielsforcongress.org]
In the last week, you've heard a lot about my opponent, Scott Perry, the Republican Congressman called out during last week's Jan. 6 Committee hearing for seeking a pardon from Donald Trump for his role in the insurrection, but you may not have heard much about Perry's opponent.
I'm Shamaine Daniels, the Democrat challenging Scott Perry in November. I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself, and I wanted to ask for your help.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6EM89Va1XA [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6EM89Va1XA]
The stakes are high in this election. Scott Perry is one of the most dangerous members of Congress. You already know about his role in the plot to overturn the election, but Perry's story doesn't end there.
With his recent election as the Chair of the Freedom Caucus - the most extreme, far-right faction in the House, he’s more dangerous than ever. Scott Perry is an embarrassment to all Americans. He MUST be stopped, and we CAN stop him.
PA-10 is the best opportunity to flip a Pennsylvania Congressional seat from Red to Blue in 2022. Click here to make a contribution to flip this seat and defeat Scott Perry [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I’m a different type of candidate than we have run against Scott Perry in the past. My family moved to this country from Venezuela when I was 13. My Mom worked hard and gave us a good life. I worked hard too. I went to college, then law school and became an attorney fighting for civil rights, workers’ rights, and immigrants.
In 2013, I was elected to Harrisburg City Council. Now in my third term, I’ve worked hard fighting for many of the same constituents whom I will represent in Congress. On City Council, I led the effort to help small businesses open with less red tape and lower fees, and fought for affordable, habitable housing.
If you want to defeat Scott Perry and invest in an experienced candidate who will also bring a fresh perspective to Congress, we need your help. Click here to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I’m also a mom who worries about my daughter’s future. I want my daughter, and all of our children, to grow up in an America where she is treated equally and paid fairly, a country where her voice and her vote matters, and where she has more and better opportunities to build the life she wants. I also want to leave her a world that isn’t threatened by climate change and where the water is safe to drink and the air is safe to breathe.
If you share these priorities. If you want your children and their children to grow up in a country, and a world, where the future is bright, CLICK HERE to make a contribution and join our team. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I hope you’ll support my campaign so we can defeat my dangerous opponent and work together to create the America we all want to see.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

Peter, public school teachers are absolutely essential. They have critically important jobs that should be valued and honored. And let’s be clear — no teacher should have to work a second or third job just to make ends meet. Teachers should be starting their summer vacations right about now. | | School's out and the history lessons are over, right? Not quite! In our latest episode of _Civics for the Culture_ , Fair Fight Action’s Chelsey Hall takes us through a brief history of voting rights in America from 1776 to 1965 — and how it’s clear that voting = power for the people. As we continue this fight, it’s important we all learn the long history of both progress and setbacks for voting rights in our country — to understand how we got to this moment, and the work we have left to do. [_**Click here to watch the latest episode of Civics for the Culture and learn how you can fund our voter education programs like this one.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46624344/351070064/-1483750133?refcode=em_20220617_f_f_cftc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDliNDg2MC0zZGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rCBYw6v5qwwfWSlsnxS9aYUhlu_dEMsEgIWnZZLhlwI=) Part One of this series takes us all the way back from 1776 to 1965. Chelsey explains the barriers to voting we’ve experienced, even after our rights were enshrined in the Constitution (well, for some people). From the Jim Crow era grandfather clauses to poll taxes and literacy tests, white men limited others’ access to the polls and kept the power for themselves. **In other words: Voting is our power.** Voting is the best way we can make effective change in our communities, states, and systems. We had to fight tooth and nail to get the freedoms we currently have, and democracy can never be taken for granted. It’s how we can continue to make progress for issues we care about like health care, climate change, racial justice, and reproductive rights. Fair Fight Action programs like _Civics for the Culture_ help equip voters with everything they need to know about the voting process. And it helps the next generation learn how to have an informed voice in politics. [_**Supporters like you help make voter education programs like this possible. If you’re able, please chip in $20 or whatever you can to help fund our voter education and empowerment programs ahead of this November’s important midterm elections.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46624346/351070070/-1483750133?refcode=em_20220617_f_f_cftc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDliNDg2MC0zZGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rCBYw6v5qwwfWSlsnxS9aYUhlu_dEMsEgIWnZZLhlwI=) Thank you for your continued support and activism, The Fair Fight Action Team

name: =?utf-8?Q?Shawn=20Hyland?=
subject: ICYMI: Confronting partisan apostasy
body:
If you are like me, I cherish the national ties that bind our nation together. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us5.campaign-archive.com/?e=5167ed8367&u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=582b29d3ab)
---
[](https://shawnhyland.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=520a402748&e=5167ed8367)
| | | | | | _Peter,_ America appears to be a deeply divided nation at its core. Our constitutional compact is tested every election cycle. Red states and blue states are in constant friction and competition. If a conservative state passes a law to reflect the will of their people, a progressive state will introduce a radical law that diametrically opposes the conservative state. It’s a game of public relations, political showmanship, and of course fundraising!It is easy to believe there are two different Americas that are fundamentally at odds with one another. And that any shared values or common culture America once had, has now been swept away by an influx of diverse ethnic and religious groups. That is simply not true.From inflation and gas prices to mental health and public safety; people from all political affliations are angry, frustrated, and scared with the direction that our country is currently heading. That’s why I ran on a platform of stronger families, safer neighborhoods, better schools, and more economic growth. **I know every society rises or falls based upon the health of these institutions.** Americans do not want to see broken and dysfunctional families, high crime rates, failing test scores, and high prices for consumer goods. _Even the democrats in San Francisco and New York City have realized that soft on crime anti-police rhetoric was doomed to failure from the start!_ Human nature would have it no other way _._ The tension America is currently experiencing is not the clash of an irreconcilable majority of citizens. It is the polarized fringes that both sides have entertained and have now empowered. Political parties are only as powerful as the broad coalition of groups they can assemble under one big tent. This has caused intra-party divisions between moderate and more ideological factions. As the internal party debates help develop a unifying platform of policy positions, it equally has moved the Democrat and Republican party further away from any middle ground that represents middle America.Therefore, when elected officials work together in negotiations and dialogue to take the best ideas from each perspective to pass a bipartisan bill, **they become guilty of what I term “partisan apostasy” – the perceived abandonment of their political party.** They are immediately condemned by ruthless, destructive, and vengeful voices on social media.I find this tragic. Finding solutions and the ability of Congress to get things done for the American people used to be applauded. Congressional approval ratings have been historically low because very little was accomplished. Now it’s the opposite. In stunning contrast, elected officials are insulted and demeaned for solving problems.**My friends, we must do better. If you are like me, I cherish the national ties that bind our nation together.** We should not appease the radical demands of the Far Left _or the Far Right_. We must not allow ourselves to become detached from our neighbors or isolated in our echo chambers. While I consider myself a strong conservative, I do not believe division and dishonesty is healthy to our nation, nor will it lead to the reconciliation so desperately needed.
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# Working for a Better America,
Shawn Hyland|
---

| | | Millions of senior citizens rely on their Social Security benefits to pay their bills – and with rising costs of housing, healthcare, and more, those benefits have not kept up. To make matters worse, Americans could stop receiving their full benefits by 2035 – unless Congress acts to fund Social Security now. That’s why Senators Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren introduced a bill that would extend Social Security’s solvency for 75 years by raising taxes on the wealthy AND increase benefits by $2,400 per year! The Social Security Expansion Act is exactly what our country needs. But Republicans are dead-set on gutting Social Security. We can’t allow seniors who have worked and paid into Social Security for their entire lives fall into financial ruin. This is urgent – add your name to support Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren’s Social Security bill. clean_body: | | | = Friend, I'm Val Demings, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio and win better, stronger leadership for the people of Florida. Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: I cannot win this without you. = Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine. The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. = In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: 6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. Are you in, friend? = From the bottom of my heart, friend, thank you for being on my team. —Congresswoman Val Demings = | | | | ---|---|---|--- If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please . | Paid for by Serve America PAC Serve America PAC PO Box 2013 Salem, MA 01970 United States

body:
We’re excited to welcome this America First fighter to our team.. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-8878295?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

Election integrity is one of the most important issues of our time. That’s why we’ve added a heavy hitter to our team.

**I’m excited to welcome Jeffrey Clark as a Senior Fellow at the Center for Renewing America**. Jeff is an experienced attorney who worked tirelessly to advance America First policies in the Trump Administration’s Department of Justice.

He brought up legitimate concerns to President Trump about potential voter fraud in the 2020 Presidential Election. This isn’t just a defensible action, but one that true patriots should be proud of.

Now he’s under intense scrutiny from the January 6th committee. It’s clear they want to make him a centerpiece of their witch hunt despite the fact that he fought to expose potential voter fraud.

**Jeff risked his career to help expose voter fraud in the last election and we’ve got his back.**

As the J6 committee hearings line up their next targets, Jeff recently [made an appearance](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d2a3f6e033&e=17913c7d6d) on Steve Bannon’s _War Room_ to discuss what we can expect to see.
---
|
---
| **WATCH: Jeff Clark on Steve Bannon’s War Room**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=a70b9416f3&e=17913c7d6d)
---

During his [appearance](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=22d7ba5ba2&e=17913c7d6d), he mentioned the only thing he wanted regarding the 2020 Presidential Election was “ _a thorough investigation like I think millions of the American people wanted_.”

He also slammed the J6 hearing as a “ _kangaroo court process without any adversity designed to try to destroy its targets_.” One thing is clear, Jeff Clark is a talented legal mind, a man of integrity, and he pulls no punches.

Make sure to check out his full appearance and follow him at [@JeffClarkUS](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ea28e25786&e=17913c7d6d).

**A Look Ahead: The Battle for 2024 and How You Can Help**

Like Jeff mentioned on _War Room_ , election integrity is going to continue to be a major issue so Americans can have confidence in their vote.

We brought him on to lead the charge, but we’re going to need all hands on deck to ensure the radical left can’t mess with our elections.

| [FIGHT BACK NOW](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=9fd61ab3ce&e=17913c7d6d "FIGHT BACK NOW")
---
| [Make a generous donation to the Center for Renewing America and join the fight to ensure our elections are fair and without fraud!](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=41ea9a0483&e=17913c7d6d)

As always, thank you for your support. Together we can ensure we uphold the integrity of our electoral process.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

| | Good Evening! Over the past several weeks I have experienced a mix of emotions. I grieved with all of you, and all other parents, after the massacre at the Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, TX. I was inspired by our youth at the March for our Lives Rally \- and by all Rhode Islanders who have stood-up for reproductive rights - who are pressing for action, and real change. But I also feel a knot in my stomach, because our country is in a place of such division and turmoil. Perhaps most poignantly, I am hardened by my resolve to help change laws and systems, which I will do if I am fortunate enough to win your vote and serve in Congress. [Please donate today!](https://www.bahforcongress.com/so/c2O5iYHUY/c?w=_LNN7ReaP28XBlqqoe8j2m9MNxscBvFulFDHPNpU9sg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JhaC1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMiIsInIiOiI2NjljZWI3YS05Y2VlLTQ5MGUtMTI0Ni1kNWIwNGU1Y2ZkOTkiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiZTY3ZDc2Yi05M2JkLTRlOWItOTJhOC04OTI0NDdiYzc2MzkifQ) Our state, country and world are full of paradoxes - we have the highest rates of gun violence in the world, but our “leaders” won’t consider common sense, comprehensive gun legislation; America is the “land of the free” but a bunch of men are deciding what a woman can do with her body; we live in the land of opportunity, but access to that opportunity is too often limited by your zip-code. name: Peter Franchot
subject: Latest Endorsement Alert!
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I am thrilled to have received the endorsement of one of Prince George’s County’s most innovative leaders: Former Seat Pleasant Mayor Eugene W. Grant! As the longest serving Mayor in the history of Seat Pleasant, Eugene has spent decades delivering concrete results to his community. He paved the way for Seat Pleasant to become a “smart city,” using technology and analytics to save taxpayer dollars and offer more personalized services to residents.
Eugene, thank you for your trust and friendship. Your leadership represents a 21st century approach to city governance that can and should be replicated elsewhere in the state. As Governor, I look forward to partnering with you to make it happen. As part of my vision for our future, I’ll make critical investments in major infrastructure projects like statewide 5G, renewable energy, and public transit to create 100,000 new jobs and ensure Maryland’s economic leadership for decades to come. You’ve helped make Seat Pleasant a test bed for innovation within our state. Let’s make Maryland a test bed for innovation within America.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=20.22]
In these final weeks before the primary election, our movement continues to grow stronger by the day. I’ve already received more endorsements from current and former elected officials and labor unions than any other candidate for Governor, and we have even more announcements to add to our coalition of support!
With the July 19 primary just weeks away, now is the time to maximize the impact of your support. Fresh off the heels of this announcement, we’re looking to raise $2,355 that will help us print more yard signs and field literature, place more phone calls and knock on doors, and ultimately secure the votes that we need to win this competitive race.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement]
My bold vision for the future of Maryland includes combating the student debt crisis, investing in the next generation of internet connectivity, lowering the costs of healthcare and housing, and leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders. Together, we can deliver on these concrete points of progress, and lift our communities into the high quality of life that they deserve.
Our people-powered movement would not be possible without grassroots supporters like you. Any amount you can spare, whether large or small, will make a critical difference in the fight to secure a stronger future for Maryland’s communities in the years to come.
Click here to chip in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eugenegrantendorsement?amount=20.22]
Thank you,

**_Madison knew that, with citizens being able to bear arms, they would not be forced into submission by a tyrannical government - without a fight!_**

Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she's a "boy" and hid it from her mother...

So, we're dragging the teachers and school into court to make them pay for their disgusting actions and stop this from happening to other children.

[**But to win this critical case I need your help today. That is why I'm asking you to join me by donating to make sure these radical teachers can't brainwash any more children.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z51f036ead1t8i5k4kkkaf6jqp1qa072j1n85ik8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5ge1o74cph2bs)

In case you missed the details of our case when I announced it with Laura Ingraham on her great **Fox News** show **The Ingraham Angle** let me recap it for you.

One day Jessica Konen, a mother of a young 12-year-old girl in middle school was called in and told by the school that her daughter was now a "boy."

What she found out was that over the past several months teachers indoctrinated her sixth-grade daughter into believing she was transgender and bisexual.

Her daughter didn't even know what those two words meant until these sick activist teachers infected her daughter with their twisted beliefs...

The teachers recruited Jessica's daughter to join their "Equality Club" where she was told she may be transgender and bisexual.

The teachers then helped her to create a totally new identity with new names, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom.

They even created a "Gender Support Plan" for her and instructed the faculty to use her new male name and pronouns -- ALL without her mother's knowledge.

And worse than that -- **these radical teachers told Jessica's daughter NOT to tell her mom because she couldn't be "trusted."**

The actions of these teachers and the school are sickening...

They intentionally hid their radical indoctrination from Jessica -- even though the Supreme Court has consistently ruled that parents have the right to control their children's education.

Left-wing activist teachers, administrators and schools are out-of-control...

It's disgusting. It's awful. And we have to stop them.

That's why I'm asking for your help today.

[**Will you join me to make these Left-wing activist teachers and the school pay for their illegal actions?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zoojel9hnibnaddg0bvlboma9t6ofbk1fv7ugt80_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5ge1o74cph2bs)

You see, we are suing the school AND the teachers for their illegal actions...

Because the only way we're going to stop these activist teachers and administrators is to drag them into court.

The fact is that we have no idea how many other children this is happening to across the country -- Jessica's daughter is just one example.

We know the California Department of Education and the teachers' associations train schools and teachers to keep secrets from parents...

Who knows how many other young children are being poisoned?

Left-wing radicals are using our classrooms to brainwash our children and grandchildren with their sick-and-twisted views.

And we have an opportunity to stop it.

This lawsuit puts every single activist teacher, administrator and school on notice -- if you mess with our children, **we will see you in court!**

They should be teaching our children math, reading and history -- not pushing them to become transgender or bisexual.

But, to stop this from happening -- we need to win this case...

That's why I'm asking for your help immediately today.

[**Will you please step up and make a generous donation to help us drag these radical activists to court?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zv6q6k3b5v5ai2igoobagc0rk6924bgo7pjc54e0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5ge1o74cph2bs)

And please know here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits -- we **WIN** them!!

My name is Harmeet Dhillon and you may recognize me from my numerous appearances on **Newsmax** and **Fox News** with **Laura Ingraham** , **Tucker Carlson** , **Shannon Bream** and **Fox and Friends.**

I've been on a lot talking about our numerous legal battles and victories against the radical Left.

We've already won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court.

We're also taking the fight to big tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives...

But this case to stop activist teachers from corrupting and hurting our children and grandchildren is so important -- it's one we cannot afford to lose.

[**That's why, I'm asking if you can give today -- $35, $50, $100, $250 or more. I will use it to protect our children and grandchildren from the radical Left.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjsfjact5or4s66t4fvusb2b9360enkua4sm43a0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5ge1o74cph2bs)

So, the next time a radical teacher wants to poison another child with their sick beliefs they'll know that we're watching and are ready to drag them into court...

That is the only way we're going to stop them -- they have to fear the consequences of their actions!

With your help, we'll hold these teachers accountable for brainwashing and grooming their young students- and we'll put all radical leftist teachers on notice that they won't get away with their plot to indoctrinate our kids and erase our parental rights.

Thank you in advance for your support.

**God Bless,**

Yesterday afternoon, the Senate voted to pass legislation that will cover health care costs for veterans suffering respiratory illnesses linked to exposure to toxic burn pits.
#
Derek —
Yesterday afternoon, the Senate voted to pass legislation that will cover health care costs for veterans suffering respiratory illnesses linked to exposure to toxic burn pits.
We share this news, first, because this is an important victory for millions of veterans who spent considerable time next to burn pits in Iraq and Afghanistan and have had health care benefits routinely denied.
But also because we have been fighting for this legislation for years. We have worked with members of Congress. We’ve mobilized veterans and military family members.
And we want to say thank you.
Because the truth is, our work wouldn’t be possible without the people who volunteer, sign petitions, talk to members of Congress and DONATE to fund that work.

When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system around me to help me through.
#

[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-june22.PHGn67&refcode=em220617-1-7&refcode2=3087.6688874.8lo4jc&t=1&akid=3087%2E6688874%2E8lo4jc)

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system around me to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard during her recovery in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.
I could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my re-election, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Trump and our eventual opponent to hold this seat.
[**Please, can you make your first $3 contribution to my re-election campaign before our June FEC fundraising deadline ends? The June 28 Republican primary election in Illinois's 15th congressional district was supposed to be a cakewalk for establishment liberal incumbent Rodney Davis (R-IL). He's the kind of Republican Washington loves: a big-spending, anti-gun corporate lapdog.

| | | **Dear Peter,**

Texas Governor Abbott has always been pro-gun, anti-choice, and anti-voting rights.
* He once said expanded access to guns will, “[instill freedom in the Lonestar State](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=6b436429db&e=0faa9de128).”
* He also said said we must, “[work tirelessly to make sure that we eliminate all rapists](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=5c899d9a6b&e=0faa9de128),” when asked why he was effectively forcing women to carry a pregnancy to term, even in cases of rape and incest.

When my opponent, Mr. Trone, was asked why he donated $45,000 to Governor Abbott, and other extremist pro-gun, anti-choice Republicans, he said, “[I sign my checks to buy access](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=2e37dd0a94&e=0faa9de128).”

[**Trone donated $45,000 to Abbott. Can you donate $45 to help me _beat him_?**](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=2941741d44&e=0faa9de128)

**I can win this primary with your help. Thousands of ballots are already in mailboxes and on kitchen tables. We need to raise at least another $25,000 to reach voters right now.**

Trone can afford to spend $45,000 to “buy access” while many people in MD-6 struggle to buy gas. **And real Democrats from Gaithersburg to Garrett County sure don’t give to Governor Abbott!**

[**Please click here to donate today. $22.50, $45, $90, $135, $225, $450 - whatever you can give makes a huge difference in a grassroots campaign like ours and will help send our pay-to-play member of Congress home.**](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=489cbd3436&e=0faa9de128)

I don’t know what Rep. Trone really believes after giving to Abbott and Paxton and others. But here is what I do know – his donations to “buy access” have consequences. When money is the fuel driving our political system – which it unfortunately is – he might think it makes sense to donate to someone like Gov. Abbott. But let’s be honest about the consequences.

Expanded gun access means more gun deaths and school shootings.

And without Roe v. Wade, politicians like Gov. Abbott will finally get their way and outlaw abortion.

Big Money and self-serving donors “buying influence” put right-wing extremists like Abbott and Paxton in office.

We only get one Representative in Congress. We can do better!

Thank you for everything you do for this campaign. One more month until Primary Day.

**[Click here to donate!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=15d27c0458&e=0faa9de128)**

Sincerely,

Ben

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z40qto2iifk0besa0o136g8u7ngnno3e6ibicc1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5ie0pb6cdh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. ## "Best Equipped To Take On Lauren Underwood"

| OSWEGO, Ill. (June 17, 2022) - Senator Sue Rezin (SD38), a leading conservative voice in Illinois' legislature, endorses Kendall County Board Chairman, Scott R. Gryder, frontrunner for nomination of the Republican Party to challenge Lauren Underwood for Illinois' 14th Congressional District.
Calling Gryder the candidate "best equipped to take on Lauren Underwood in November," Senator Rezin highlighted Scott's "proven track record of strong leadership and sound fiscal policy."
Contrasting Underwood's "far left, progressive ideologies," Rezin believes Gryder will "bring his common-sense conservatism to Washington, D.C. and will focus on stopping wasteful spending, protecting patients' rights, standing up for our veterans, and securing our borders."
Upon receiving the endorsement of Senator Rezin, Gryder released the following statement:
"My campaign for Illinois' 14th District is being waged on behalf of the hard-working families struggling under the policies and failures of leadership exhibited by Lauren Underwood and her allies in Washington, Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi. It's time for a change, and I am honored that Senator Sue Rezin, a conservative leader we know and trust believes my pro-growth, pro-family, pro-freedom approach is the right choice for our district and our future. I thank Senator Rezin for her friendship, her confidence in my leadership, and her support as I prepare to take on Lauren Underwood."

#
Hello Peter Willis,

My life changed dramatically 30 years ago with an unexpected divorce, but as you know, that catapulted my life into advocacy.

I had been an advocate all my life. As a mother, I always advocated for my children, but I realized later that I could do much more good if I were an advocate for the people.

But I didn't realize that my voice was needed until 28 years ago when I managed to run my first political campaign!

And it was all due to a mindset shift.

Here's what happened. After I resolved that I was an advocate for the people, I set out to educate everyone on the role that I was running for. I held meetings, voter registration drives, rallies, and even campaigned to educate voters and share my message. The more I educated people, the more support I received, and I knew I was going in the right direction. Even though I didn't win my campaign in 2014 and 2020, I never gave up.

The 2020 campaign motivated me to continue sharing my message and show that our democracy works when we get involved as active participants. I realized that this movement was not about me. It’s about you and your voice. It is time to hear the people's voices.

I’ve never been so excited about anything in my life! We’ve kickstarted a fantastic transformational process to bring your voice to the table where decisions are being made on your behalf. Realizing this gave me renewed hope and has inspired me to keep going. I’m working to become The People’s Representative from Georgia 12. I’m ready! You’re ready! We’re ALL Ready to go from surviving to thriving together!

I want to meet with you via zoom on Thursday, June 23rd at 7 pm EST. I want to update you on what's next for this campaign and my goals for District 12 and the American people. I also want to give you a voice. I want to hear your concerns and how I can support you, so I hope you will attend.

Let's connect and discuss freedom, security, and opportunities for all. These three words are the bedrock of our great nation and the platform of this campaign. If you would like to attend, I would love to receive your support for our Liz Johnson for Us campaign. Everyone who donates will get on a special list and receive an email registration link for this special meet and greet virtual event. No amount is too small.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Hello Peter Willis, My life changed dramatically 30 years ago with an unexpected divorce, but as you know, that catapulted my life into advocacy. I had been an advocate all my life. As a mother, I always advocated for my children, but I realized later that I could do much more good if I were an advocate for the people. But I didn't realize that my voice was needed until 28 years ago when I managed to run my first political campaign! And it was all due to a mindset shift. Here's what happened. After I resolved that I was an advocate for the people, I set out to educate everyone on the role that I was running for. I held meetings, voter registration drives, rallies, and even campaigned to educate voters and share my message. The more I educated people, the more support I received, and I knew I was going in the right direction. Even though I didn't win my campaign in 2014 and 2020, I never gave up. The 2020 campaign motivated me to continue sharing my message and show that our democracy works when we get involved as active participants. I realized that this movement was not about me. It’s about you and your voice. It is time to hear the people's voices. I’ve never been so excited about anything in my life! We’ve kickstarted a fantastic transformational process to bring your voice to the table where decisions are being made on your behalf. name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: We’re relying on you right now, Peter.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I’m writing to you today because things are tough at a critical time
(again). Here’s the situation:

We had a really strong fundraising month in May that helped us catch up
from months of declining fundraising. But now, our fundraising has dropped
steeply yet again. This drop is not sustainable — not as we try to lift
Kina Collins to victory on June 28 and expand the Squad in Congress.

We operate on a pretty tight budget, especially compared to other
political organizations. It’s because we run solely on donations from
grassroots supporters like you. We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs.

Our grassroots supporters have been there to support our
work, Peter. And
I’m so, so grateful for the continued support of regular everyday folks
(not billionaires).

Our average donation this year is just $18.21. We’re proud of that. It
means we need a lot of small-dollar donations to fuel our primaries.

You may know by now, but we started Justice Democrats after many of us
worked on the Bernie 2016 campaign. We were all inspired and determined to
find a way to continue the message of Bernie’s campaign through electing a
new Congress that truly represented the needs of the people.

That’s when we launched Justice Democrats and supported a lot of
candidates in our first election year (2018). We lost a bunch of races,
but then we won one big one: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s groundbreaking
victory against the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House.

We recruited and elected Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in 2020, defeating
two more powerful corporate Democrats. This year we’ve already won two
races — Greg Casar in Texas and Summer Lee in Pennsylvania. Now, we need
to make sure Kina wins her 6/28 primary against the Democratic
establishment. We need to make sure we can build the necessary support in
Congress for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and so much more.

That’s why I’m asking,
Peter: can you make
your first
donation to Justice Democrats today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110594?refcode=em20220617-23886&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23886%2E1203867%2Exqc0vS ]→ Yes, I can donate today to help build the Justice Democrats bloc in
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110594?refcode=em20220617-23886&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=23886%2E1203867%2Exqc0vS ]Contribute

I appreciate so, so much whatever you can give today, whether it’s $3,
$27, $100 or anything at all. We will never take corporate PAC money and
we will always rely on our grassroots movement.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

| | Peter, We can’t seem to get consistent answers from Andy’s primary opponent on some of our most pressing progressive issues. **On health care?** During her 2018 campaign, she advocated for Medicare for All, but now she opposes it, and she’s campaigning on a plan that would still render millions of Americans without health insurance. A flip flop, and one that will cost us. **On prescription drugs?** She ran on lowering costs, but soon sided with Big Pharma to oppose the progressive plan — the very same progressive plan Andy’s fought to enact. **And on the Supreme Court?** At a time when expanding the Court would help protect many rights — like the right to a safe abortion — she’s refused to give a straight answer. Andy, on the other hand, is all in on expanding the Court and exploring more ways to reform this institution. A strongly Democratic district like the new 11th needs a dependable and trustworthy representative who’ll deliver on our progressive priorities, and that candidate is Andy Levin. He’s been a consistent, progressive champion since the beginning, and you can trust that he’ll continue to fight for all of us. [_**Peter, can you donate $11 ahead of the primary election and help move Andy one step closer toward re-election?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46653571/351173914/478999150?refcode=em_20220617_f_t_flip&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2YyMDliNS03MmVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wpeSmFee5mcuNQD4CW5rS7vkYHEzkaYHCzc30m6Znn4=) Andy’s primary opponent has been consistent in one distinct way: **She’s still taking corporate PAC donations to fund her campaign. Andy doesn’t.** So when she flip-flops on these important policy issues, who is she taking cues from — corporate donors instead of working people? After all, she endorsed billionaire Mike Bloomberg for president in 2020 after he’d spent $2.2 million on her first campaign. Meanwhile in 2020, Andy was traveling the country supporting Elizabeth Warren, who’s now supporting him for re-election as a champion for working people. Our democracy is hanging by a thread, and we can’t afford to put our country’s future in the hands of someone’s whose vote may or may not be for sale. But defeating our opponent and her big money machine is going to take the strongest grassroots coalition, so we’re hoping you can pitch in today. | Friend,

**Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita here.**

California liberals are attempting to manipulate our court system to impose an extreme Green New Deal agenda on all of America.
**_I'm fighting back._**

It's simple, Friend. Left-wing activists in San Francisco shouldn't be crafting environmental policy for the entire nation. But that's exactly what an activist California Court's decision demands - and the implications would devastate domestic energy production and increase the pain of Biden-flation from which American families are already suffering.
**It is absurd to enable California's judiciary to set policy on a global issue that affects all 50 states.** Hardworking Americans in Indiana and across the nation should not be ruled by radicals on the West Coast.

_[That is why I have filed an amicus brief](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=149e13338d&e=edf8a4d16d)_ \- signed by 14 fellow Republican Attorneys General - to reverse this extreme decision and restore common sense and the Rule of Law.

**\- It’s time: #BigDemWeekend - ** It’s time. Big Dem Weekend is here! For tonight's Hoosier Hospitality Dinner and State Convention this Saturday, Democrats from across the state will meet in Indianapolis to celebrate the brighter future our leaders like André Carson and Frank Mrvan have created for Hoosier families. Below is an overview of our special guests, statewide candidates, this year's Lifetime Achievement and Activist of the Year honorees:

body:
#

Friend, this just changed everything: **Adam Laxalt (R) is officially the GOP nominee for Senate here in Nevada, where he and I will face off this November in the race that will determine control of the Senate.**
Keeping this seat and the Senate blue will come down to your grassroots support. So I’m urgently asking you: [**Will you split $5 or more right now between my campaign and Alex Padilla so we can keep Nevada and the Senate blue?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22-ccm.osuHhO&refcode=em220617-1-90&t=1&akid=857%2E159979%2Ehwzkcq)
Your support right now could not be more important: The Cook Political Report, National Journal, and Roll Call have all named me the most vulnerable senator in America — and **Nate Silver himself at FiveThirtyEight says this is the GOP’s best pickup opportunity.**
**Polling already shows me 3 points down, that’s why Mitch McConnell and his super PAC are about to unleash $18 MILLION on vicious attack ads to defeat me.**
_The first few days of the general election are crucial._ But McConnell’s attacks will completely overwhelm us and drown out my voice in this vital moment – unless I can raise the resources to fight back. That’s why I set an ambitious general election fundraising goal, but with time running out before the midnight deadline, I’m falling dangerously short.
[**Please, friend, I’m personally counting on you: Will you become a general election founding donor and help us hit this goal so we can defeat Adam Laxalt, win in Nevada, and defend our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22-ccm.osuHhO&refcode=em220617-1-90&t=2&akid=857%2E159979%2Ehwzkcq)
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22-ccm.osuHhO&refcode=em220617-1-90&t=3&akid=857%2E159979%2Ehwzkcq)**
Laxalt has the entire force of the MAGA movement behind him, not only because he led the Big Lie conspiracy theories for Trump in Nevada, but because he would be a guaranteed vote on a national abortion ban.
This isn’t just about winning a Senate race, friend — it’s about the future of our democracy and the values that we share.
[**I need your support more than ever before.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22-ccm.osuHhO&refcode=em220617-1-90&t=4&akid=857%2E159979%2Ehwzkcq)
_¡La lucha sigue!_ The fight continues!
Catherine

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Big Tech’s campaign of censorship
body:
Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9280%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=VM9eqBtinBbObbhRH58bQA&sysid=1)
[****](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35661%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NMxyKicda44WKpO0XXpYQg&sysid=1)

Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**>> DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5KqSevngxWR1BNUe9RFPEg&sysid=1)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself - the time is NOW.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35663%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xmGXg0WuzFZig%2bNwKQr%2fmg&sysid=1)
[**If you’re with me,**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35664%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hQS8uk1AMqFuBa974PjcJA&sysid=1)[**Friend****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35675%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S7y1NRTGOtE4bjOhbwKfNQ&sysid=1) I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=b1a931e080ad4f30be89eb99e15559ad&_e=f_ljnFmhSMf7vygF_7f6VW8YA_UxgXJ_YkuXK9Wit9_TtXJDR_Ck7KhBH-UjapKJHec4OqHRJTWGiuA0ujemBoMUjkHbaIU70N-nvV8yKfwvJYt6Kf6rVrKiu0p4f7jCsj6fY_isjLgy4vwmTLh8nH-YRk47oX6pzAvDq0m3roomFXOAnmmv1wkyLlR2d-Ca5hzoQ_Fv6zAehEWXW4cCWm9TzWcZ4maNxE-qCoYpdmLB4jO9CFL6FPjedoiMK9fKJCk9832F_ywbUylQZqbjpUCgs1CaKMXSwz0Hhamrub7EqEzL8p4wofmdOoiXzbkATZzOSSgTF-9BR3DTwR8ybnaSTTfWMI9hMgi4WCb7eKV_r5T9UvJBXSvvsXYDTrOdsh62tPXpMw6P-XMnRVwWCPe4OJM6hpq8QPVBfZ64ml8EpUo-llVs-zfNkyQXWxF_KxoZhPjgS9TykgLx5dUktQ%3D%3D)**_
## Do you believe the American education system is failing millions of young Americans?
[YES](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=b1a931e080ad4f30be89eb99e15559ad&_e=f_ljnFmhSMf7vygF_7f6VW8YA_UxgXJ_YkuXK9Wit9_TtXJDR_Ck7KhBH-UjapKJHec4OqHRJTWGiuA0ujemBoMUjkHbaIU70N-nvV8yKfwvJYt6Kf6rVrKiu0p4f7jCsj6fY_isjLgy4vwmTLh8nH-YRk47oX6pzAvDq0m3roomFXOAnmmv1wkyLlR2d-Ca5hzoQ_Fv6zAehEWXW4cCWm9TzWcZ4maNxE-qCoYpdmLB4jO9CFL6FPjedoiMK9fKCFz-3-tqustPgdT3iYvCmCve4Ol2SaIKWyD4mh5NKG7BAeg4g69Bjvmz-IROfcMKSL7twxKQuK87ft9pBfUo75yhJ_VlFdcR_Tw_zJS6muLC4n8EmZre9JWS56hyA-kSFkl0ZBGNUsL9LdwyWT3GdgcMjK724F4Mmfz5EiACrxbDJPbUzXJXMch0aftTeDXnJcTLO-C8bv8XF27Rjm__sg%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=b1a931e080ad4f30be89eb99e15559ad&_e=f_ljnFmhSMf7vygF_7f6VW8YA_UxgXJ_YkuXK9Wit9_TtXJDR_Ck7KhBH-UjapKJHec4OqHRJTWGiuA0ujemBoMUjkHbaIU70N-nvV8yKfwvJYt6Kf6rVrKiu0p4f7jCsj6fY_isjLgy4vwmTLh8nH-YRk47oX6pzAvDq0m3roomFXOAnmmv1wkyLlR2d-Ca5hzoQ_Fv6zAehEWXW4cCWm9TzWcZ4maNxE-qCoYpdmLB4jO9CFL6FPjedoiMK9fK6S5uZJs_SoSCSgTRRwGtKh9Hxy-G4YucY-f_ZIRC3jN198CC7Rme2yaTrfpdDznWWL9HJemrv2VC9DkKZd5wAPb7EI6OLqaxo-YW00pGeiLpdQwVSQ1TmLM3YHGoc4DSkUtXIraOAbAHvVj75xPyZQUtlq7mpifDMuGsyeAj5IFxGv_WSFIPZ9G_MZHbzfOrPTRyJ1LeHnC658uGlebbIg%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our new, nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this new campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand:
* WHAT the Constitution says
* HOW it relates to current issues and events
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ in the coming year, and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=b1a931e080ad4f30be89eb99e15559ad&_e=f_ljnFmhSMf7vygF_7f6VW8YA_UxgXJ_YkuXK9Wit9_TtXJDR_Ck7KhBH-UjapKJHec4OqHRJTWGiuA0ujemBoMUjkHbaIU70N-nvV8yKfwvJYt6Kf6rVrKiu0p4f7jCsj6fY_isjLgy4vwmTLh8nH-YRk47oX6pzAvDq0m3roomFXOAnmmv1wkyLlR2d-Ca5hzoQ_Fv6zAehEWXW4cCWm9TzWcZ4maNxE-qCoYpdmLB4jO9CFL6FPjedoiMK9fKwcajlIupX5O83wVUnyoESYCz4fdQSvMc2hcdTz8-lSyVetI3nZ92NaRe4Zt7QPiD9DPd7y3elrUDWoPEwhyo6Nlh2UtoyFMRQEfe0SJLTL4AgY2G-JTvFt3Fs5zY5ncc60j1WpL8jB7KbW2eXIRsvttA-MNodQMLWZ1sj_xnIDyoAfnXnI7MQO74hcymBSiD-wontFdirQSOZ3AgSm8-9w%3D%3D)

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: Are you still awake?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I know it's late, but I've got a lot on my mind keeping me up tonight.
| | |
---
Hi there, Peter, it's Trudy. I know it's late, but I've got a lot on my mind keeping me up tonight.
As a nurse, as a mother, and as a grandmother, I'm really worried about the future of our country. Far too often, our leaders are choosing politics, partisanship, and their own careers over the people who they're supposed to serve.
Meanwhile, healthcare is getting harder and harder to afford, the opioid epidemic is continuing to tear our communities apart, prices for basic necessities are sky high, and it's getting so much more difficult for hardworking families to to get by.
So that's why tonight I'm up late worrying about our country and the families who are hurting the most right now. And here's the thing: I know that there are thousands of other Americans in this exact moment, unable to sleep, worrying about the issues facing their families.
I've promised that as senator, I'll put people first. For me, that starts with listening to the people who are up late worrying – people like you. So whether you're worried about how you're going to keep the lights on, how you're going to give your kids every opportunity to succeed, or how we're going to unite our country and heal the divisions between us, I want to hear from you.
So please, can you take just a minute or two to fill out my priorities survey and tell me what keeps you up at night? It would mean so much to hear from you. Here's the best link: **[https://surveys.signforgood.com/tbv-are-you-up](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46655039/351182714/1921613654?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk52-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDIxNmZjNC03OGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zChIV-zSZbcYARtcXUgJsSLTzvHRHgf7DCnYn-sXJ8c=&emci=edad4e68-69eb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=94216fc4-78ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

clean_body: I know it's late, but I've got a lot on my mind keeping me up tonight. | | | Hi there, Peter, it's Trudy. I know it's late, but I've got a lot on my mind keeping me up tonight. As a nurse, as a mother, and as a grandmother, I'm really worried about the future of our country. Far too often, our leaders are choosing politics, partisanship, and their own careers over the people who they're supposed to serve. Meanwhile, healthcare is getting harder and harder to afford, the opioid epidemic is continuing to tear our communities apart, prices for basic necessities are sky high, and it's getting so much more difficult for hardworking families to to get by. So that's why tonight I'm up late worrying about our country and the families who are hurting the most right now. And here's the thing: I know that there are thousands of other Americans in this exact moment, unable to sleep, worrying about the issues facing their families. I've promised that as senator, I'll put people first. For me, that starts with listening to the people who are up late worrying – people like you. So whether you're worried about how you're going to keep the lights on, how you're going to give your kids every opportunity to succeed, or how we're going to unite our country and heal the divisions between us, I want to hear from you.
