body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

On Saturday, June 11, my family and I marched in solidarity with
Louisville's youth to call for an end to gun violence.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220617.SLggES&refcode=em20220617-2083&t=1001&akid=2083%2E346206%2ETy-kEj ][IMG]

Later that night, while holding Baby Justyce, I learned of a mass shooting
a few blocks from where we marched that left several young people fighting
for their own lives.

My heart breaks thinking about how much our community has been through.
Gun violence is and has been an unyielding public health crisis. Our
solutions must be comprehensive, and they must be immediate. Thoughts and
prayers are not enough, but they are still needed.

Peter, we are
still marching for our lives. We are marching for our children, who
deserve to learn in our schools, not be gunned down. We are marching
because inaction is not an option.

Enough was enough a long time ago. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220617.SLggES&refcode=em20220617-2083&t=1021&akid=2083%2E346206%2ETy-kEj ]I am running to retire Rand Paul
this November so we can FINALLY pass common sense gun reform. Please help
me win this race by chipping in today:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220617.SLggES&refcode=em20220617-2083&t=1022&akid=2083%2E346206%2ETy-kEj ]Contribute $5

Peter, the
Second Amendment was never meant to be a license for school shootings and
daily homicides.

But as long as the NRA and gun lobby are around — and politicians like
Rand Paul accept their donations — this constitutional right will be what
it was never supposed to be.

That’s why I’m running against Rand Paul, a Senator with a 92% NRA rating
who’s accepted more money from the gun lobby than any other Senate
candidate this year. Rand Paul has made it clear that he will always vote
to please his donor friends from the gun lobby rather than save lives.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220617.SLggES&refcode=em20220617-2083&t=1023&akid=2083%2E346206%2ETy-kEj ]But Peter,
we don’t have to keep accepting inaction from Senate Republicans like Rand
Paul. Will you chip in $5 right now to show that we the
people are demanding common sense gun reform by ending his career?

Thank you,

Charles

Even yesterday, after witnesses told us that Vice President Mike Pence was literally at grave personal risk of attack on January 6th, Pence would not agree to participate himself in the 1/6 Committees’ proceedings to get to the bottom of what happened that day.

The outrageous murder of nineteen children in their own elementary school should be enough to spur our leaders into taking action. ** ** Instead, we've seen these kinds of mass shootings happen consistently throughout America without any serious effort by our elected officials to put an end to them. 20 mass shootings have occured since the tragedy at Uvalde on May 24th. ** ** Other than his prayers, Max Miller hasn't proposed any concrete action on how we can protect innocent lives. In fact, Miller is actively working against saving lives. Max opposes background checks and sensible gun regulations that would prevent these kinds of tragedies from ever occurring again. Unfortunately our happiness was tempered by the fact that the LGBTQ+ community is under attack all around the country. From bigoted sports bans to legislation preventing queer history from being taught in schools, conservatives are hell-bent on erasing the existence of LGBTQ+ identities.
Federal laws supersede state laws, which means Congress can directly undo this damage being done by homophobic and transphobic Republican state legislatures.
We have a moral obligation to protect the LGBTQ+ community — our friends, family and neighbors. **A****s a co-founder of an LGBTQ+ non-profit, Melanie takes protecting these lives seriously. In Congress, she will always fight to ensure the equality and safety of our LGBTQ+ communities by:**
* Passing the Equality Act to finally ban discrimination based on gender, gender identity, and sexual orientation in employment, housing, education, public accommodations, federally funded programs, credit, and jury duty.
* Eliminating bans on blood donations from gay, bisexual, and queer individuals.
* Ending discrimination in adoption and healthcare.
* Supporting LGBTQ+ youth by ending discrimination in housing and banning conversion therapy nationwide.
* Creating more government acknowledgment of the LGBTQ+ community, including updating government-created job applications and census questionnaires, and providing additional funding for issues pertaining to the community.

| HOW HAVE JOE BIDEN, NANCY PELOSI AND DAVID TRONE CHANGED YOUR LIFE?
---
| | |
---
|
---
| Hey! Mariela Roca here.
Earlier this week, Joe Biden [angrily shouted](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t_XJiUumR21k_yLcEG63Pi1rGAtl_6sxEi9o4WhA6fZZF2TJfLXNvtjc4ESN7lDNbOoGPsWlZoVJmvVdIX7aXJ0LJNkWCXfZrepwptaaJbvR9sjYzojXlbX2h5h86cb5mYj9d-CNDLMQJSJKoBtnN8kXodma96aPd-IcPVcDRyi_Al9e5DaAvkYlH4mk9aF4cgomSnA-rMnk5JE1Wp_7Kc6wqemEJfVzmjShgCp2NAlbjO0Q63VcUqm_-AfhFV27&c=cOOiH4NuRi0-qASKf5z_LB3FZInK5BXWCUu47IOPOft_lk97bHuoeQ==&ch=dDDWiCyYsqb-PKHW8IZfZYdVbch3GdaL_qbG1q9mFQVto9uhiYXKaA==) at an AFL-CIO crowd that "we're changing people's lives" and that he didn't want to hear any more about reckless spending. All while inflation is costing [average Americans an extra $460 a month](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t_XJiUumR21k_yLcEG63Pi1rGAtl_6sxEi9o4WhA6fZZF2TJfLXNvtjc4ESN7lDNxkZr5VP_j3-ABP67bxhUN6Kw1p6k9x2bgXs7cUuKTSLI_AHAOnITvZ-KmqRbhFq9Ube8HzrKJFFjtzakL2mAqg1TUVhyO7LNpBkyk6T0o94gk_O7BqOMYJKLleFOn3EPK6S2HfXTS9mkD7W4scFgV8aiismuwtiDamRObxjMFJG6zXhAo6hF4g==&c=cOOiH4NuRi0-qASKf5z_LB3FZInK5BXWCUu47IOPOft_lk97bHuoeQ==&ch=dDDWiCyYsqb-PKHW8IZfZYdVbch3GdaL_qbG1q9mFQVto9uhiYXKaA==)! Can you believe this stuff?
There's certainly no disputing that Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, David Trone, and the Democrats are changing lives, FOR THE WORSE!
Changing the value of our savings, with sky-high inflation. Changing the amount we spend on gas. Changing our national sovereignty with wide-open borders. Changing our children with radical gender and racist indoctrination. Changing what we read and hear with censorship, with help from Big Tech.
This past week, Youtube took down the 6th District Primary Debate we had last month (which I won, btw). They allege "misinformation." It's a DEBATE, and now voters have fewer ways to compare the candidates. How's that for so-called "democracy"? Also this week, White House climate advisor [Gina McCarthy declared that Big Tech should censor critics](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t_XJiUumR21k_yLcEG63Pi1rGAtl_6sxEi9o4WhA6fZZF2TJfLXNvtjc4ESN7lDNeJHcCT43IQZEOU6EyfFtUzHE6t9yXV2VbRWe5QU8EjKKalWpydUX7nDV9p3dkcryHFEnBDgh9BYRUEpzXkKcUXiSR1BQBK2fgPWmzBUa0zmgS20s_MaehgHsZ1kNQ_J8zdO5DJmYo4fJqwsdBqX6xqpzN1DtkLMdUDevgrY988tchaudPExVAZqat-huPipbfVbaqE1pyU4=&c=cOOiH4NuRi0-qASKf5z_LB3FZInK5BXWCUu47IOPOft_lk97bHuoeQ==&ch=dDDWiCyYsqb-PKHW8IZfZYdVbch3GdaL_qbG1q9mFQVto9uhiYXKaA==) of the administration's energy policy, in the name of the "public health." Are you paying attention yet?
All these buzzwords are just cover for an increasingly far-left, authoritarian-leaning Democratic Party and their attempts at keeping power. They can't win on the issues, so they stifle debate. In our case LITERALLY.
WE HAVE TO FIGHT BACK. JOE BIDEN AND THE DEMS ARE A DISASTER. That's why I'm running for Congress!
I am:
A proud mother of two, who was born and raised in Puerto Rico An Air Force combat veteran who served in Afghanistan Someone who grew up poor and knows the value of hard work Unapologetically patriotic, with America-First values Ready to fight against far-left Dems, media hacks, and big tech censors!
I want to be your voice in Congress! I want to represent hard-working, patriotic Americans in Maryland! But, as a first-time candidate, I NEED YOUR HELP!
WE ARE RUNNING A GRASSROOTS CAMPAIGN. We don't have elite DC connections. We're knocking on doors, meeting voters face-to-face, and running on small donations from people who just want to make a difference!
The JULY 19th primary is just four weeks away, and we need [YOUR HELP RIGHT AWAY](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t_XJiUumR21k_yLcEG63Pi1rGAtl_6sxEi9o4WhA6fZZF2TJfLXNvqTA4-LunvOyPRn80qsCvCXVHfIpOeCisOlU-JqSnrZNVeZDTq2PBVlEuMZzFLMlYPGzRRUeSy1WmMVAlrKrb1ujA55TsyyJOhWHEMXJXKaD3XG3CL5KsFlAYKCXuTGj_A==&c=cOOiH4NuRi0-qASKf5z_LB3FZInK5BXWCUu47IOPOft_lk97bHuoeQ==&ch=dDDWiCyYsqb-PKHW8IZfZYdVbch3GdaL_qbG1q9mFQVto9uhiYXKaA==) to help me win the nomination and send open-borders promoting, ACLU-funding, inflation-increasing, big tech supporting sad trombone David Trone and the left-wing disaster that is the Democratic Party PACKING in November.
I am the Democrats' worst nightmare and have the best chance to win against far-left, ultrarich Democrat David Trone and his millions in campaign funds! I can appeal to Hispanics, moms, veterans, and working-class people in ways none of the other candidates can! David Trone would love to face anyone but me.
WE NEED YOU TO HELP US KEEP THE RED WAVE GOING STRONG! Will you pitch in $25 to help my campaign? $50? $100? $500? Whatever you can do to help, please consider it! We've got a country to save, let's do this!
For America, for our kids, for our economy, FOR FREE SPEECH! FOR THE TRUTH! We have to win! Let's go!

clean_body: The GOP is continuing to attack LGBTQ+ rights | | | Hi Peter – Over a video explaining the word "transgender," Wisconsin Republicans ran ads saying Democrats were funding “radical school lessons.” GOP lawmakers were also told to look for "inappropriate" books being taught in their districts. This disgusting behavior by Republican representatives is being replicated in states across the country. In fact, more than 300 anti-LGBTQ+ bills are pending in state legislatures nationwide. And the GOP is putting money and action behind this strategy, so far spending at least to run TV ads attacking transgender rights. House Republicans in Ohio even went so far as to pass a bill that would ban transgender girls and women from participating in high school and college sports, including a process of "verification" by checking the genitals of students "accused" of being trans. This is nothing short of outrageous. Republicans are creating a school system that is so hostile toward LGBTQ+ individuals, especially students, that experts have warned this could have serious mental health and education ramifications. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46656374/351189193/357640498?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220617_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjVhM2JkNy03ZmVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vm02OtRKqZ7eO8d54O7xFqnOvdk_aFxAot86prXu3CE=) My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46656375/351189194/357640498?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220617_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjVhM2JkNy03ZmVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vm02OtRKqZ7eO8d54O7xFqnOvdk_aFxAot86prXu3CE=) You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. **After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.** The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. **There’s less than 24 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $100,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:** **[Please, may I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Martin Heinrich’s today – before our fundraising deadline? Every dollar you can give today will help me build a campaign to defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46656376/351189195/357640498?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220617_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjVhM2JkNy03ZmVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vm02OtRKqZ7eO8d54O7xFqnOvdk_aFxAot86prXu3CE=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will immediately be split between Michael Franken and Martin Heinrich:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46656377/351189196/357640498?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220617_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjVhM2JkNy03ZmVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vm02OtRKqZ7eO8d54O7xFqnOvdk_aFxAot86prXu3CE=)

My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. = You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. There’s less than 24 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $100,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask: = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will immediately be split between Michael Franken and Martin Heinrich: | | = = | = = | = = With Senate control on the line, I am so grateful to have the support of people like you. I think my mom and dad would appreciate the support, as well. Thank you, Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.) VICE ADMIRAL FRANKEN (RET) IS A FORMER MEMBER OF THE U.S. NAVY. What happens in November isn’t a foregone conclusion. And if this grassroots team can match the Republicans dollar-for-dollar in fundraising, we WILL win here in Pennsylvania. Eleven of the 13 victims were Black Americans. This act of terror was inspired and initiated by a white supremacist conspiracy called the “Great Replacement Theory”— a deeply harmful ideology that describes a false plot where non-white immigrants are entering America to disempower and subjugate white people. **It is a tool used to justify Islamophobia, xenophobia, and mass murder.** Peter, we can no longer wait for Congress to take action. That’s why I introduced House Resolution 1152 to clearly address the tragedy in Buffalo, NY, implement a national day of remembrance, and urge the whole of Congress to be diligent in combating white supremacy. I’m proud to say it passed with 218 votes. [_**Will you sign on and stand with me and House Democrats as we call for immediate action to end white supremacy? House Resolution 1152 is not just a one-off action. It’s about continuing to look at where white nationalism lives and breathes in our democracy and our law enforcement. We often believe that Republican rhetoric is so outrageous that American people aren’t going to be influenced by it. Yet, the Great Replacement Theory has been highlighted hundreds of times by conservative news sources and has been invoked by mass shooters at the Tree of Life synagogue in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania in 2018, in El Paso, Texas in 2019, and by the Christchurch shooter in New Zealand, in 2019. **If this rhetoric radicalizes just one person to commit mass murder, then we have failed as a Democratic Party, and irreversible damage has already been done. We need to do everything in our power to push back against it.** Peter, the swift passage of this resolution is but the first of many steps in our fight to rid our nation and our democracy of white supremacy once and for all. clean_body: Peter, I need your help today. | | | Peter, On May 14, an 18-year-old gunman viciously took the lives of 10 Americans and injured three more. Eleven of the 13 victims were Black Americans. This act of terror was inspired and initiated by a white supremacist conspiracy called the “Great Replacement Theory”— a deeply harmful ideology that describes a false plot where non-white immigrants are entering America to disempower and subjugate white people. It is a tool used to justify Islamophobia, xenophobia, and mass murder. Peter, we can no longer wait for Congress to take action. That’s why I introduced House Resolution 1152 to clearly address the tragedy in Buffalo, NY, implement a national day of remembrance, and urge the whole of Congress to be diligent in combating white supremacy. I’m proud to say it passed with 218 votes. The Buffalo shooting was one of the worst racially motivated massacres in New York’s history. I can remember sobbing in my car, terrified of taking my children to school as I thought about what could possibly happen to them. I just couldn’t bear it — and that’s why this work is so deeply personal and important to me and millions of Americans across the country. House Resolution 1152 is not just a one-off action. It’s about continuing to look at where white nationalism lives and breathes in our democracy and our law enforcement. We often believe that Republican rhetoric is so outrageous that American people aren’t going to be influenced by it. Yet, the Great Replacement Theory has been highlighted hundreds of times by conservative news sources and has been invoked by mass shooters at the Tree of Life synagogue in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania in 2018, in El Paso, Texas in 2019, and by the Christchurch shooter in New Zealand, in 2019. If this rhetoric radicalizes just one person to commit mass murder, then we have failed as a Democratic Party, and irreversible damage has already been done. We need to do everything in our power to push back against it. Peter, the swift passage of this resolution is but the first of many steps in our fight to rid our nation and our democracy of white supremacy once and for all. Peace and love, Jamaal Bowman | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

| | **Happy Father’s Day weekend, friend!** I consider myself blessed beyond measure to have an endless list of fathers whom I love and admire. My father, Tom, was a World War II Veteran and a Lincoln City Councilmember who led our community with an open heart and an open mind. He raised five children with all the love in the world and instilled in us the fundamental belief that **when we all put our heads and our hearts together, there is _nothing_ we can’t conquer.** He passed away when I was young, and I miss him every day. My father was the hardest-working man I’ve ever known, and when I’m on the floor of the Legislature or speaking at a rally, he is the voice in the back of my mind telling me to go forward in my fight with compassion. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46658152/351197206/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220617_fathersday&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220617_fathersday&refcode2=109773d6-88ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk3NzNkNi04OGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JaN5cMXyj2nHHqlJcn9z3FWq2XmRFXkiN4N6c149RGA=) My darling husband, Loel, is the light of my life, and the most amazing father to our three beautiful children! Even in the midst of legislative and campaign chaos, Loel is the calm, loving, and steady rock that anchors our family. Loel is my law partner, most trusted ally, and the strongest supporter of every venture our children have pursued. He is somehow able to move mountains to get all five of us to the family dinner table at the end of a crazy day, and has navigated our family through tough times and made hard sacrifices to help our family thrive. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46658153/351197207/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220617_fathersday&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220617_fathersday&refcode2=109773d6-88ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk3NzNkNi04OGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JaN5cMXyj2nHHqlJcn9z3FWq2XmRFXkiN4N6c149RGA=) **Raising a family with Loel has shown me that being a parent requires sacrifice, but it shouldn’t require choosing between a day off and putting food on the table.** Many of my colleagues in work and in the Legislature balance the long hours, extended sessions, and trips across the state between raising families of their own — all while making sure they _never_ miss a single soccer game on the weekends. **Working with incredible dads warms my heart — and it motivates me even more to fight for a better future for our kids.** **Being a dad or a father figure isn’t easy, though — especially without resources like paid family leave to help fathers put being a parent _first_. **Our working parents need support to raise their families, and they deserve people who will fight for them to get the help they’re asking for. Friend, it’s time we put our families first — and I’m ready to ensure Congress delivers on things like paid family leave and affordable child care. **[Will you help support my fight this Father’s Day weekend?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46658156/351197208/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220617_fathersday&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220617_fathersday&refcode2=109773d6-88ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk3NzNkNi04OGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JaN5cMXyj2nHHqlJcn9z3FWq2XmRFXkiN4N6c149RGA=)** _If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly._ | | [**DONATE $10**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46658162/351197216/333259033?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=em_220617_fathersday&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220617_fathersday&refcode2=109773d6-88ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk3NzNkNi04OGVlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JaN5cMXyj2nHHqlJcn9z3FWq2XmRFXkiN4N6c149RGA=)

clean_body: I consider myself blessed beyond measure to have an endless list of fathers whom I love and admire. | = | | Happy Father’s Day weekend, friend! I consider myself blessed beyond measure to have an endless list of fathers whom I love and admire. My father, Tom, was a World War II Veteran and a Lincoln City Councilmember who led our community with an open heart and an open mind. He raised five children with all the love in the world and instilled in us the fundamental belief that when we all put our heads and our hearts together, there is nothing we can’t conquer. He passed away when I was young, and I miss him every day. My father was the hardest-working man I’ve ever known, and when I’m on the floor of the Legislature or speaking at a rally, he is the voice in the back of my mind telling me to go forward in my fight with compassion. = My darling husband, Loel, is the light of my life, and the most amazing father to our three beautiful children! Even in the midst of legislative and campaign chaos, Loel is the calm, loving, and steady rock that anchors our family. Loel is my law partner, most trusted ally, and the strongest supporter of every venture our children have pursued. He is somehow able to move mountains to get all five of us to the family dinner table at the end of a crazy day, and has navigated our family through tough times and made hard sacrifices to help our family thrive. = Raising a family with Loel has shown me that being a parent requires sacrifice, but it shouldn’t require choosing between a day off and putting food on the table. Many of my colleagues in work and in the Legislature balance the long hours, extended sessions, and trips across the state between raising families of their own — all while making sure they never miss a single soccer game on the weekends. Working with incredible dads warms my heart — and it motivates me even more to fight for a better future for our kids. Being a dad or a father figure isn’t easy, though — especially without resources like paid family leave to help fathers put being a parent first. Our working parents need support to raise their families, and they deserve people who will fight for them to get the help they’re asking for. Friend, it’s time we put our families first — and I’m ready to ensure Congress delivers on things like paid family leave and affordable child care. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly. | | = = | = = | = = I hope you all celebrate the fathers, the father figures, and those who have filled an irreplaceable role in your hearts this weekend! body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220617&amount=28 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220617&amount=28]
Team,
Every time June comes around, I end up thinking about my mom.
After my parents got divorced in the 1980s, my mom came out in suburban Detroit. It was by no means easy, especially in those years, and it has given me a deep appreciation for the progress we have made since then.
My mom passed away in 2011, four years before the Supreme Court would rule in favor of marriage equality. It makes me smile to think of how excited she would have been and, despite the favorable outcome, how determined she’d still be to continue the work of advancing equality.
That piece – the work we still have to do – has been on my mind constantly the past few months. From a host of bills proposed in state legislatures, to tense fights at school board meetings, to scare tactics about our children’s well-being being used as a cynical ploy to make a quick buck (as my opponent did in a text last month when he solicited contributions as a means of canceling “your child’s gender reassignment surgery,”) it’s clear that we still have work to do to advance the cause of equality.
If my mom was still alive, she would be saying “live and let live.” She’d be fighting for people to have the personal and legal freedom to live the lives they want to live.
So this month, I’ll be taking a moment to celebrate, reflect on how far we’ve come, and then get right back to work. For my mom.

The State wants to regulate how you store guns in your own home and even create a registry for ammunition purchases. This is a gross affront to our liberties and it must be stopped. Click the link below to find your state representatives, if you don't already know who they are, and send them an email and/or call them and demand that they vote NO on June 22nd. As a candidate for U.S. Representative, I have an interest in protecting the rights of all people. I already reached out to my representatives and will continue to do so until they vote on June 22nd. We all need to do our part to secure our freedom and our right to self defense is one of the most important rights to defend.

clean_body: If we’re going to even have a progressive movement, we have to do this. | | | Peter, From the mass shooting in Buffalo last month to other senseless acts of mass murder around the country, these terrorists often cite one thing: The white supremacist “Great Replacement Theory.” This terrible ideology is used to justify islamophobia, xenophobia, antisemitism, racism, and mass murder, and it’s a key tool of the white nationalist movement in our country. If we’re going to even have a progressive movement and build a true multi-racial democracy, we have to push back hard against this kind of vile white supremacy. That’s why I’m proud to stand beside my fellow Justice Democrat, Rep. Jamaal Bowman, and other progressive leaders in the House of Representatives and around the country as we fight back against this racist rhetoric. Earlier this month, the House of Representatives passed a resolution to condemn this theory and to call for an end to white supremacy. Our opponent Mark Green voted against the resolution. We need to come together to say enough is enough. That’s why I’m joining progressive leaders from every corner of the U.S. and calling on an end to this “replacement theory.” Thank you! Odessa | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

body:
Largest Tax Cut for Veterans in Virginia history
| | |
---
| | [](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com/1/0100018172f21613-ef252cfc-219b-4094-b83b-ba090bc857b9-000000/Ar1iNjPfboTRy6DLLnJIL2dFekk=274)
---
| Largest tax cut for Veterans in virginia history
---
| Friends,
---
| I am so excited to be able to finally say that the bill I fought tooth and nail to pass for the last three years has finally been codified into Virginia law today, giving our veterans the much-needed and well-earned tax cuts on their pensions that they deserve.
---
| | |
---
| I won't lie: it took a lot of blood, sweat, and tears to finally get this through. Not only was this one of my personal goals, but also one of Governor Youngkin's “promises made, promises kept”. The bill went through some changes as it passed through the House and Senate originally, but we were able to agree on hundreds of millions of dollars worth of tax cuts over the next few years for veterans 55 and older. As you can see below in a breakdown of the tax cuts, it will be a rolling cut starting at $10,000 and adding an extra $10,000 in exemptions each year until 2025, from which point it will provide $40,000 worth of exemptions annually for our military retirees. With nearly 800,000 veterans in our state, this will be an amazing boost to our economy.
---
| | |
---
| This is a major investment both in our veterans and the Commonwealth itself. Many states surrounding us already offer tax reductions, if not complete tax exemptions on veterans' pensions. We need to encourage our veterans, once they retire, to stay here in our great Commonwealth. Not only is it beneficial to our economy, but to our established way of life as Virginians considering that we have one of the highest concentrations of military personnel in the nation right here. Many veterans, after retiring from the military, go on to start a second job with the valuable skills they learned while serving, or even open up a small business (both of which I can relate to, as after leaving the Army I became a police officer in Virginia and then opened an independent insurance agency).
---
| | |
---
| I can only hope that as a Commonwealth, we continue this trend of taking care of those who have given so much to our nation. I am proud to fight for our veterans, whether it was this recent success with tax cuts, the Veterans Treatment Court system I helped start in VA that was then emulated on a national level, or the state legislation I passed helping veterans with PTSD acquire service dogs. As someone who served in the Army, I understand the trials and tribulations our veterans face when returning to life as a civilian, and would be humbled and honored to continue improving the lives of those who have served our nation as your next Congressman in the new 7th district. Thank you all for supporting my endeavors to take proper care of our service members, and I look forward to continuing to pass good, common-sense legislation for the sake of all Virginians.
---
| Yours in Service, Sen. Bryce E. Reeves

Not only was this one of my personal goals, but also one of Governor Youngkin's “promises made, promises kept”. The bill went through some changes as it passed through the House and Senate originally, but we were able to agree on hundreds of millions of dollars worth of tax cuts over the next few years for veterans 55 and older. As you can see below in a breakdown of the tax cuts, it will be a rolling cut starting at $10,000 and adding an extra $10,000 in exemptions each year until 2025, from which point it will provide $40,000 worth of exemptions annually for our military retirees. With nearly 800,000 veterans in our state, this will be an amazing boost to our economy. | | | | This is a major investment both in our veterans and the Commonwealth itself. Many states surrounding us already offer tax reductions, if not complete tax exemptions on veterans' pensions. We need to encourage our veterans, once they retire, to stay here in our great Commonwealth. Not only is it beneficial to our economy, but to our established way of life as Virginians considering that we have one of the highest concentrations of military personnel in the nation right here. Many veterans, after retiring from the military, go on to start a second job with the valuable skills they learned while serving, or even open up a small business (both of which I can relate to, as after leaving the Army I became a police officer in Virginia and then opened an independent insurance agency). | | | | I can only hope that as a Commonwealth, we continue this trend of taking care of those who have given so much to our nation. I am proud to fight for our veterans, whether it was this recent success with tax cuts, the Veterans Treatment Court system I helped start in VA that was then emulated on a national level, or the state legislation I passed helping veterans with PTSD acquire service dogs. As someone who served in the Army, I understand the trials and tribulations our veterans face when returning to life as a civilian, and would be humbled and honored to continue improving the lives of those who have served our nation as your next Congressman in the new 7th district. Thank you all for supporting my endeavors to take proper care of our service members, and I look forward to continuing to pass good, common-sense legislation for the sake of all Virginians. | Yours in Service, Sen. Bryce E. Reeves | | | | | | | | | | | | P.O. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [The Final Six Weeks](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorR8J6nWWJxyMm-x8MOnqJw&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june17_final&n=1) Yesterday, the bill to let 12-year-olds get vaccinated without parental consent was amended to make the age 15. The author was well short of the needed votes. He still appears to be short. The amendments were only adopted by a vote of 33-21; for the bill itself to pass, 41 votes are needed. I am again calling for SB 866 to be withdrawn. Meanwhile, the Legislature passed a $300 billion budget that does nothing about gas prices. I don’t know which is worse: that we're at $5 nationally or that in California this seems like a bargain. There are two weeks until the Legislature recesses for July. We are back in August, and then adjourn for the rest of the year. That means we’ll only be in session six more weeks in 2022 – my final six weeks at the State Capitol. For these final weeks, my priorities include stopping SB 866 and the remaining “Vaccine Work Group” bills, passing my legislation to eliminate the Top 2 Primary, and finally enacting a suspension of the gas tax. In addition, my proposal for a statewide audit of all homelessness spending – to end the homeless industrial complex – should be heard on June 27. The last time I proposed this Newsom intervened to kill the audit by a single vote. At the same time, we are gearing up for the general election. The Democrats are eyeing this seat as a chance to stop us from taking the Majority, so Pelosi can stay Speaker. For the sake of our country, we cannot let that happen. body:
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15188?t=6&akid=3305%2E878179%2E5lgjBj) Friend,

We've had a lot of curveballs thrown our way, but we haven't let them distract us from winning this race.

In fact, they've motivated me to work even harder and fight for the people of Upstate New York. And now that **new maps have officially been approved** , I'm ready to hit the ground running in the new 19th Congressional District.

We can win this election in November because the power of our grassroots supporters is strong. We've come this far due to grassroots contributions from working folks like you pitching in $5, $10, or whatever they can afford. [**So, can you help us build momentum in our new district by splitting $5 between my campaign and Voter Protection Project now and becoming one of our very first NY-19 donors?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15188?t=7&akid=3305%2E878179%2E5lgjBj) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Riley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15189?t=8&akid=3305%2E878179%2E5lgjBj)

I've dedicated my career to fighting for working people, and I know Wall Street doesn't need another vote in Congress. But, working families do.

| | Happy Father’s Day! This weekend I am thankful for two main reasons: 1\. For my daughter Isabel, aka “the boss.” She has given me the gift of fatherhood, and I am forever grateful for that. I didn’t think I would ever be so lucky to have a kid like Isabel. The day I officially adopted her was the best day of my life. Being a father is a privilege. It is nothing short of amazing, and I can’t wait to continue to watch her become the impressive young woman she is becoming today. 2\. To have been so fortunate to have the man that raised me—my dad. I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again, my father is my hero. He molded me into the man I am now. He was selfless, wise, generous, and had a great sense of humor (where do you think I get mine from? 🤣) My father served in the Marines during World War II. He saw horrific bloodshed and sacrifice, but his takeaway was that freedom is worth defending in the face of tyranny. When he came home, he became a teacher and was beloved by his colleagues and students. It didn’t matter who you were, he treated everyone with respect. He taught me to take service seriously but never to take myself too seriously. He taught me the importance of family and neighbors helping neighbors. He taught me that at the end of the day, no matter the situation, a kind word or deed goes a long way. My dad was a part of the Greatest Generation, and he was indeed great.

name: Tanisha Sullivan
subject: Juneteenth is Freedom Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Tanisha M
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tanisha4ma?refcode=email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tanisha4ma?refcode=email]
Friend,
This weekend our country will commemorate Juneteenth.
Although this day became a federal holiday in 2021, it has been commemorated in the African American community for generations. I am excited that this year the African American community will lead celebrations across Massachusetts, welcoming people from various backgrounds into our cultural experience. It is my hope that more people will come to know and understand the historical significance and lessons of this important day.
Juneteenth is also known as Freedom Day.
It falls on June 19th recognizing that day in 1865. That is the day soldiers from the 5th Regiment reached enslaved Black people in Galveston, TX with word that the Emancipation Proclamation, marking the end of legal slavery in America, was signed on January 1, 1863.
Juneteenth is a reminder that our laws are merely words on paper until we do the work needed to ensure those words have impact. It took 2.5 years of intentional focus, determination and belief that freedom would be experienced for all Black people enslaved in America for those in Galveston to experience the impact of the Emancipation Proclamation.
So it is today. Democracy doesn’t just happen. We have to work at it. It’s not enough that people have the right to vote on paper...we have to do the work to help ensure they cast a ballot. It’s not enough that public information is available...we have to do the work to ensure it is accessible. It’s not enough that we have the ability to start businesses...we have to do the work to ensure that business success is experienced by our main street businesses.
Democracy in action. We have to do the work to achieve freedom, justice and equality for all. What would our country be like if the Emancipation Proclamation was signed, put on a shelf with a belief that all we needed were words on paper?
That’s what we do when we pass voting laws and are not proactive in tackling voter participation. On this Juneteenth, this Freedom Day let's commit to ensuring that we will not leave any community behind. Let’s commit to increasing voter participation- together.

clean_body: [] Friend, This weekend our country will commemorate Juneteenth. Although this day became a federal holiday in 2021, it has been commemorated in the African American community for generations. I am excited that this year the African American community will lead celebrations across Massachusetts, welcoming people from various backgrounds into our cultural experience. It is my hope that more people will come to know and understand the historical significance and lessons of this important day. Juneteenth is also known as Freedom Day. It falls on June 19th recognizing that day in 1865. That is the day soldiers from the 5th Regiment reached enslaved Black people in Galveston, TX with word that the Emancipation Proclamation, marking the end of legal slavery in America, was signed on January 1, 1863. Juneteenth is a reminder that our laws are merely words on paper until we do the work needed to ensure those words have impact. It took 2.5 years of intentional focus, determination and belief that freedom would be experienced for all Black people enslaved in America for those in Galveston to experience the impact of the Emancipation Proclamation. So it is today. Democracy doesn’t just happen. We have to work at it. It’s not enough that people have the right to vote on paper...we have to do the work to help ensure they cast a ballot. It’s not enough that public information is available...we have to do the work to ensure it is accessible. It’s not enough that we have the ability to start businesses...we have to do the work to ensure that business success is experienced by our main street businesses. Democracy in action. We have to do the work to achieve freedom, justice and equality for all. What would our country be like if the Emancipation Proclamation was signed, put on a shelf with a belief that all we needed were words on paper? That’s what we do when we pass voting laws and are not proactive in tackling voter participation. On this Juneteenth, this Freedom Day let's commit to ensuring that we will not leave any community behind. Let’s commit to increasing voter participation- together. As the Left continues with its reckless policies, our economy continues to suffer. Inflation rates reached 8.6% and gas prices skyrocketed to an average of $5 per gallon. We are breaking records — but not the good kind! Americans are struggling to cover the cost of groceries, a tank of gas, and additional expenses. Biden has placed the blame on Putin, the pandemic, and everything but his administration. He refuses to take responsibility for his reckless spending and anti-energy policies. Conservatives have solutions to put America back on track, but first we have to win back our majorities in November.

**ANOTHER GREAT DAY IN SOUTH CAROLINA**
---
Nancy Mace won big in South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District. On Sunday and Monday, Ambassador Nikki Haley hit the campaign trail alongside Mace, rallying by her side at two great events. On Tuesday, Rep. Mace won her primary for reelection and heads into November with huge momentum.

Last Saturday, Alaska held a special election for the sole congressional seat in the state. After a 48-way primary, Sarah Palin came out on top. But the race is not over yet. Next, Sarah Palin will compete against three of the other top contenders in an election on August 16. Sarah Palin is a patriot and champion of conservative values. We can’t wait to watch her run circles around Nancy Pelosi in Congress.

This will be an incredibly tough fight in Nevada, but Joe is a conservative fighter and he can win this fight if we have his back. Let’s work together to get him across the finish line.

subject: Q&A: Chris Miller, Illinois Freedom Caucus Chairman
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
## Patriots,
On May 5th, we helped launch the Illinois Freedom Caucus, the 5th state to join our State Freedom Caucus Network. Below is a Q&A session that we recently did with its chairman, Chris Miller. We hope you enjoy it.
---
|
---
Representative Chris Miller speaks before the Illinois Freedom Caucus at their launch in Chicago, Illinois, May 5th, 2022.
|
## **Q &A: Representative Chris Miller,
Illinois Freedom Caucus Chairman**
---
| **Tell us about yourself. How long have you lived in Illinois?**

I’m the State Representative for District 100th, which is Southeastern IL. I’m a lifelong Illinois resident. I’ve lived in Illinois for 68 years. My family has lived in the Coles and Douglas County area for over 100 years. We’re an agriculturally based family. I spent four years getting my BA in Education at Eureka College where former President Ronald Reagan also went to school. I had the privilege of meeting him while I was there. I also played football up there. My wife and I have been married 42 years this coming July. We have seven children and 19 grandchildren. We farm corn, soybeans and wheat and raise purebred Angus herd which comes to about 100 pairs of angus cattle. We raised children with the philosophy for them to learn work, serve and suffer. The farm has been a perfect environment to achieve all those goals.

**How has Illinois politics affected your life as a farmer? **

The problem as a farmer is that we always struggle, as a small family farm in particular, to make ends meet. Illinois has decided they want a very hostile environment for businesses and families with burdensome real estate taxes, income taxes and every other way they can tax us. They’re killing small family farms and small businesses. We’ve lived in our house for the last 42 years. When we moved in our real estate taxes were $900. Now the real estate taxes are $5,000.

**What made you want to run for office?**

What really triggered me was that we had a 32% tax increase that passed. The guy who held my seat voted for the tax hike. He knew he wouldn’t be re-elected again after voting for it. Two current state representatives approached me and asked if I would run and I said I would.

**Why are you a conservative?**

When you look at conservatism and how you would define that, in my mind, it means they are principled people, for one. Secondly, there are three defining documents for a conservative, which is the Word of God, our Constitution, and the Republican Party platform. If you remain true to these defining documents, you have a line in the sand and won't get off into the weeds. Also, when you think of conservatism, in my mind, there’s seven planks that define a conservative which are individual liberty, limited government, rule of law, fiscal responsibility, fair markets, the precious sanctity of life and understanding the idea of peace and restraint. Those define who I am as a conservative.

**How will the Illinois Freedom Caucus work with the Republican party?**

What the ILFC is doing is calling the Republican Party back to the foundations that make us Republicans. The Constitution and the Republican Party platform have to take precedence. The establishment Republicans think the pathway to victory is through compromise and acquiescent to the Dems and the far left wing of the party. I personally think the pathway to victory is to be who you are, to stand for the platform and have a backbone filled with iron knowing we aren’t compromising but staying true to the things that make the Republican party the Republican party. We’ve worked our way into a super-minority through poor leadership and straying away from the fundamentals, so to say, the faith of our party. The only way to restore confidence in the grassroots of the Republican Party and actually, the people that make it move, is that we build it from the ground up. The people, the citizens want the Republicans to act like Republicans, not RINO’s, not like the establishment has or acquiesce the special interest groups that continue to destroy businesses and families in the state of Illinois. Some people would say that Illinois is a lost cause.

**What caused you start the Illinois Freedom Caucus?**

I don’t think Illinois is a lost cause. That’s why we’ve drawn a line in the sand and are standing firm to fight for the future of the great state. One thing we can recognize is that the politician thinks about the next election, but a patriot thinks about the next generation. Right now we’re focused on the next generation of Illinoisans to make life better for them. So I absolutely don’t think Illinois is a lost cause. We’ve gotten in the position where we’ve been because of bad policy. We’ve dug a massive hole and they’ve begun to cover us. Myself and other members in the Freedom Caucus are bound and determined to climb out of the hole that the Dems and RINO establishment have dug. We’re going to embrace the ideals that make America who we are and fight against all the powers that be and all the forces of the establishment RINO’s as well as the Democrats to stand firm against this tide.

The Lord said when iniquity would abound, He would rise a standard against it. We are part of that standard that is rising up. Because what they want us to do is sit down, shut up and go over in the corner. It’s time for this generation of American patriots and the Illinois Freedom Caucus to not be silent anymore but to stand up and speak up. We need to inform the citizens of Illinois of what’s going on, especially in the establishment Republican party.

**How does the Illinois Freedom Caucus plan to combat the long time corruption in Illinois
politics?**

In order to solve any problem you must recognize that you have a problem. Right now, we do have a problem in the state of Illinois and it’s been brought to you by the establishment RINO’s and the Democratic party. One of our primary missions is to educate the people and look at the facts and be able to segment and define the problems. For every problem, there’s always a solution to that problem. One thing we talk about is Habakuk 2:2 - that we “write the vision and make it plain” so that the people who read it can run with it. ILFC is coming up with solutions to fix the problems that we have here in the state of Illinois. We’re working diligently with the next Governor Darren Bailey and Congresswoman Mary Miller to actually address the reasons why Illinois is a sinking ship and begin to plug the holes one hole at a time.

**What is one way you see Illinois being turned around?**

The only way to fix Illinois is to stop electing Democrats to public office. They have no solutions. Their paradigm for governing is more borrowing, more taxes and more spending. They have no moral fiber to govern their decisions. One of the messages we have to be clear about is that in order for God to bless Illinois, we need to repent and allow the Word of God to revive our dying land. Stop electing visionless leaders. The Dems have no plan. We can see they have no plan by the way they govern. Since 2018, the state budget was $32 billion. The next budget is going to be up to $46.5 billion. If money could fix the problem, then Illinois would be on the right path. Any extra income we have is from federal money, which means you’ve been taxed again. The federal government doesn’t have any money unless they’ve taxed you again. We’re on a downward spiral and it’s time for the ILFC to be the first one to pull the jake brake.

**What do you see as the biggest issue Illinois is facing?**

The biggest issue Illinois is facing is the moral rot of our government and elected officials.

**What are some policy proposals you’d like to see passed in the 2023 legislative
session?**

Here’s the problem, to be real, we’re in a super minority. If it’s going to be business as usual, the Republican Party is not going to pass any true reforms. As long as Dems are in charge, any reform measures won’t see the light of day. As long as we have Dems in the Governor’s mansion and as the supermajority, it will be business as usual.

**What can be done? Can the ILFC help to stop these bad bills from going through?**

One thing we’ve done is establish a beachhead era in Illinois politics. Another thing we can do with some of our staff is do research and throw sand in the gears of the Democrat machine. We may not be able to stop every bad bill but we can slow it down, expose it and shout from the rooftop and from the mountain tops what’s going on and get the ear of the public. They’re governing against the will of the people. Illinois, in my opinion, is a center right state. The people don’t like what’s going on. The polling data reflect their displeasure with Governor Pritzker and Joe Biden. When you look at the raw data, it gives us hope that we’ve got their attention and they’re listening. We need to strike while the iron is hot and have a well thought out meaningful message that will resonate with the common sense, hardworking people of Illinois.

A lot of times they want to pass these terrible bills in secret in the middle of the night so no one will know about it. There is a reason they pass stuff at 2am, 3am or 4am in the morning. Even they know they are bad bills because if they were good bills, they’d be passing them in the light of day. But instead, they’re hiding in the dark hours of the night. So one of the biggest things the ILFC can do is create awareness of what’s really going on.

I spent four years getting my BA in Education at Eureka College where former President Ronald Reagan also went to school. I had the privilege of meeting him while I was there. I also played football up there. My wife and I have been married 42 years this coming July. We have seven children and 19 grandchildren. We farm corn, soybeans and wheat and raise purebred Angus herd which comes to about 100 pairs of angus cattle. We raised children with the philosophy for them to learn work, serve and suffer. The farm has been a perfect environment to achieve all those goals. How has Illinois politics affected your life as a farmer? The problem as a farmer is that we always struggle, as a small family farm in particular, to make ends meet. Illinois has decided they want a very hostile environment for businesses and families with burdensome real estate taxes, income taxes and every other way they can tax us. They’re killing small family farms and small businesses. We’ve lived in our house for the last 42 years. When we moved in our real estate taxes were $900. Now the real estate taxes are $5,000. What made you want to run for office? What really triggered me was that we had a 32% tax increase that passed. The guy who held my seat voted for the tax hike. He knew he wouldn’t be re-elected again after voting for it. Two current state representatives approached me and asked if I would run and I said I would. Why are you a conservative? When you look at conservatism and how you would define that, in my mind, it means they are principled people, for one. Secondly, there are three defining documents for a conservative, which is the Word of God, our Constitution, and the Republican Party platform. If you remain true to these defining documents, you have a line in the sand and won't get off into the weeds. Also, when you think of conservatism, in my mind, there’s seven planks that define a conservative which are individual liberty, limited government, rule of law, fiscal responsibility, fair markets, the precious sanctity of life and understanding the idea of peace and restraint. Those define who I am as a conservative. How will the Illinois Freedom Caucus work with the Republican party? What the ILFC is doing is calling the Republican Party back to the foundations that make us Republicans. The Constitution and the Republican Party platform have to take precedence. The establishment Republicans think the pathway to victory is through compromise and acquiescent to the Dems and the far left wing of the party. I personally think the pathway to victory is to be who you are, to stand for the platform and have a backbone filled with iron knowing we aren’t compromising but staying true to the things that make the Republican party the Republican party. We’ve worked our way into a super-minority through poor leadership and straying away from the fundamentals, so to say, the faith of our party. The only way to restore confidence in the grassroots of the Republican Party and actually, the people that make it move, is that we build it from the ground up. The people, the citizens want the Republicans to act like Republicans, not RINO’s, not like the establishment has or acquiesce the special interest groups that continue to destroy businesses and families in the state of Illinois. Some people would say that Illinois is a lost cause. What caused you start the Illinois Freedom Caucus? I don’t think Illinois is a lost cause. That’s why we’ve drawn a line in the sand and are standing firm to fight for the future of the great state. One thing we can recognize is that the politician thinks about the next election, but a patriot thinks about the next generation. Right now we’re focused on the next generation of Illinoisans to make life better for them. So I absolutely don’t think Illinois is a lost cause. We’ve gotten in the position where we’ve been because of bad policy. We’ve dug a massive hole and they’ve begun to cover us. Myself and other members in the Freedom Caucus are bound and determined to climb out of the hole that the Dems and RINO establishment have dug. We’re going to embrace the ideals that make America who we are and fight against all the powers that be and all the forces of the establishment RINO’s as well as the Democrats to stand firm against this tide. The Lord said when iniquity would abound, He would rise a standard against it. We are part of that standard that is rising up. Because what they want us to do is sit down, shut up and go over in the corner. It’s time for this generation of American patriots and the Illinois Freedom Caucus to not be silent anymore but to stand up and speak up. We need to inform the citizens of Illinois of what’s going on, especially in the establishment Republican party. How does the Illinois Freedom Caucus plan to combat the long time corruption in Illinois politics? In order to solve any problem you must recognize that you have a problem. Right now, we do have a problem in the state of Illinois and it’s been brought to you by the establishment RINO’s and the Democratic party. One of our primary missions is to educate the people and look at the facts and be able to segment and define the problems. For every problem, there’s always a solution to that problem. One thing we talk about is Habakuk 2:2 - that we “write the vision and make it plain” so that the people who read it can run with it. ILFC is coming up with solutions to fix the problems that we have here in the state of Illinois. We’re working diligently with the next Governor Darren Bailey and Congresswoman Mary Miller to actually address the reasons why Illinois is a sinking ship and begin to plug the holes one hole at a time. What is one way you see Illinois being turned around? The only way to fix Illinois is to stop electing Democrats to public office. They have no solutions. Their paradigm for governing is more borrowing, more taxes and more spending. They have no moral fiber to govern their decisions. One of the messages we have to be clear about is that in order for God to bless Illinois, we need to repent and allow the Word of God to revive our dying land. Stop electing visionless leaders. The Dems have no plan. We can see they have no plan by the way they govern. Since 2018, the state budget was $32 billion. The next budget is going to be up to $46.5 billion. If money could fix the problem, then Illinois would be on the right path. Any extra income we have is from federal money, which means you’ve been taxed again. The federal government doesn’t have any money unless they’ve taxed you again. We’re on a downward spiral and it’s time for the ILFC to be the first one to pull the jake brake. What do you see as the biggest issue Illinois is facing? The biggest issue Illinois is facing is the moral rot of our government and elected officials. What are some policy proposals you’d like to see passed in the 2023 legislative session? Here’s the problem, to be real, we’re in a super minority. If it’s going to be business as usual, the Republican Party is not going to pass any true reforms. As long as Dems are in charge, any reform measures won’t see the light of day. As long as we have Dems in the Governor’s mansion and as the supermajority, it will be business as usual. What can be done? Can the ILFC help to stop these bad bills from going through? One thing we’ve done is establish a beachhead era in Illinois politics. Another thing we can do with some of our staff is do research and throw sand in the gears of the Democrat machine. We may not be able to stop every bad bill but we can slow it down, expose it and shout from the rooftop and from the mountain tops what’s going on and get the ear of the public. They’re governing against the will of the people. Illinois, in my opinion, is a center right state. The people don’t like what’s going on. The polling data reflect their displeasure with Governor Pritzker and Joe Biden. When you look at the raw data, it gives us hope that we’ve got their attention and they’re listening. We need to strike while the iron is hot and have a well thought out meaningful message that will resonate with the common sense, hardworking people of Illinois. A lot of times they want to pass these terrible bills in secret in the middle of the night so no one will know about it. There is a reason they pass stuff at 2am, 3am or 4am in the morning. Even they know they are bad bills because if they were good bills, they’d be passing them in the light of day. But instead, they’re hiding in the dark hours of the night. So one of the biggest things the ILFC can do is create awareness of what’s really going on. | | "CLICK HERE TO DONATE" | | | | | Copyright © 2022 State Freedom Caucus Network, All rights reserved.

**Additionally, Warnock votes with New York's Democrat Senator Chuck Schumer 99% of the time too!** The numbers don't lie.

_**So while my opponent may claim to represent Georgia, he votes like he's the 3rd senator from California or New York!**_

**[Donate right now and send California's 3rd senator packing!](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=2dded1d1ae354caea1b33879af3b69d7&_e=6x1QFLAboYH-ZbdRdcJlPcMgM9a0eTC4Mafs38RyibIToW9l38o1RY32w8OzTQuKGGNkUVpc8lmqrPCNtWQbpwnmnDsG5Nc3kGpavwRplhb3wVQ400G1t7GOywdjmkxhnm2gvgJ20iDZX2SokJSY7_Bh_6wt-wluYSdDbbLKJCB7OUWKgYJ_gX5tbiCwyOE4E9Lpdg3A3a1t0f-X0DIfEx5yYFXyJpgPQK_Vx5_AN9ZnvIb3C1R5aWW3GwVBsTloqvVkzeotByvpR-S2mmkf_ZL_5gF5VLSIZEL7babJJY3NZ1jKZQMgMJWH276hqcWv3vRVjfRx3krvxiisWa3vUSzQpCFv8fPIA5S5JkQih5-iWBgPuO3Yji97NERbUQMNnAuRJFABsOZV0STgSmUVRijZuea0HtwYksPikwkEn55FMAlHKae_H0dDCZX6iCRHZbuq9ZaGJsB8063ncQfsBdIxjFcqNDZ6hRpdVFdSVi_MP1VmcvUTRJiDFARitOVR)**

name: anne hemingway feuer
subject: Fwd: Response from Congresswoman Maria Salazar
body:
This is an example of what Maria Elvira Salazar puts out whenever anyone contacts her about any issue. She is who Angel will be running against in November if he wins the August 23 primary. As you can see, she can't even vote for anything involving democracy, because...?? she is republican and thinks everything non republican is a partisan thing that she can't be party to? I don't think she gives much thought to any issues brought to her by any constituents.
,

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Rep. Maria Salazar** <[repsalazar@mail15.housecommunications.gov](mailto:repsalazar@mail15.housecommunications.gov)>
Date: Fri, Jun 17, 2022 at 7:07 PM
Subject: Response from Congresswoman Maria Salazar
To: Anne Elizabeth Jane Hemingway Feuer <[anneh.feuer@gmail.com](mailto:anneh.feuer@gmail.com)>

__
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Hemingway Feuer,
As your Congresswoman, your priorities are my priorities. I received your inquiry regarding the Protecting Our Democracy Act (H. R. 5314) and understand your concerns. I share your strong support for protecting the greatest democracy in the world. Unfortunately, the Protecting our Democracy Act was not a serious attempt to make reforms, but rather a partisan bill that made significant changes to Executive and Legislative powers outlined in the Constitution. This includes curbing the ability of a President to issue pardons and weaponizing subpoena power in Congress. As such, I could not support this bill. Any efforts to strengthen our democracy should be serious and bipartisan.I appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns. Please continue to send me your thoughts on how I can better represent you. The best way to keep up with my office is through Twitter ([@RepMariaSalazar](https://twitter.com/RepMariaSalazar)) and [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/CongresswomanMariaElviraSalazar). You can also subscribe to my weekly newsletter [here](https://salazar.house.gov/contact/newsletter-subscribe). It is an honor to serve you in Congress. Gracias!

Sincerely,

**María Elvira Salazar
Member of Congress**

##
17 Jun 22

**Only 4 Weeks Until The July 19 Primary.**

The campaign is in a great rhythm. Door Hangers are distributed to targeted areas Tuesdays and Wednesdays, Meet & Greets on Thursdays and Team Door Hanger Distribution & Sign Waving on Saturdays. Texts and calls are made to voters throughout the week. Thousands and thousands of voters have been impacted. Thank You!

**Juneteenth Parade**
The campaign has been invited to the Juneteenth Parade on Saturday, June 18 in District Heights.
Line up by 10a.
The parade will depart from First Baptist Heights Church of District Heights
7234 Lansdale St., District Heights, 20747
We invite you to make this event and have strong & diverse participation from the campaign.
Please arrive by 10a and leave time to park.

**Meet & Greet**
Another Meet & Greet will be held Saturday, Jun 18.
5-6p
McDonalds-Beltsville
10531 Baltimore Ave., Beltsville, 20705
Come and learn about our historic movement and meet Jeff.

**Sign Waving - One Power Hour**
There will be no sign waving Saturday, June 18 due to the parade.

**End Of The Quarter Donations**
Campaigns run on quarters and this quarter ends June 30, in 2 weeks!
Please consider a generous donation to help us finish strong and purchase the additional $4000 in signage needed for the Primary Voting locations and the additional texting to voters. Keep in mind, $7 reaches 1000 voters!
We need $5000 for texting. Every dollar matters. Thank You in advance for your support.

**Phone Calling**
Phone Calling is a key strategy to impact voters and is very simple. Many of the voters have received a door hanger and met Jeff. The pre-recorded voicemail from Jeff is an important part of our strategy to reinforce our messaging that Jeff is "Standing With You And For You!"

You can make an impact no matter where you live in the nation. Please email the campaign at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com if you’re in interested in getting trained. It's easy.

**Social Media**
The campaign is taking steps to build Jeff Warner's social media presence.
You can find Jeff under RepJeffWarner on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/RepJeffWarner) & Twitter (@RepJeff Warner).
Be sure to like, share, subscribe, follow, etc. to help us grow his following.

Thank You for your support. The campaign continues to make and break records. Come and be a part of this amazing team. Imagine how good it will be to say you were part of this team in November as we celebrate our historic victory!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=1d2215de17&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Shea Bradley-Farrell, PhD is President of Counterpoint Institute for Policy, Research, and Education (CIPRE) in Washington, D.C., a 501(c)3 non-profit organization and the voice for conservatives in the global arena. CIPRE promotes the values and merits of national sovereignty, free market economies, and the cultural foundations of family, religious liberty, and the right to life. As a policy expert and strategist, Dr. Shea provides analysis and recommendations to U.S. and foreign officials at the highest level of government. Dr. Shea is an expert in foreign policy and aid, national security, international development, women’s empowerment, and human rights. She is a Policy Fellow at George Mason University and was a professor and subject matter expert for the U.S. Defense Security Cooperation University. Dr. Shea is widely published and appears often on TV news and radio. | Yesterday, the House Select Committee conducted its latest hearing on the January 6th attack on our Capitol.

With the primary **close on our heels,** we're putting our all into **what really matters:** the voters and **people of this great state!**

This week, I had the privilege of **spending time in your communities.**

Across**seven counties** —Davis, Wasatch, Summit, Salt Lake, Cache, Weber, and Utah—I **spoke with voters** about the challenges they face **every day **and their work to **make a difference.**
---
|
---
Learning how to retire the flag with the American Legion and local Girl Scouts in Murray Tuesday.
|
---
| In **every neighborhood, city, and county,** I meet Utahns who are getting**engaged,** supporting their **community,** and taking steps to **make their voices heard** in this month's **primary election. **

With **each conversation,** I've listened to people's **desires and challenges.**

Through **your stories,** I'm learning how I can **meet those challenges, **for our state and our nation, **in Washington D.C. **
---
|
---
Spending time with voters, and a few future voters, in Woods Cross on Thursday.
|
---
Hanging out on the Yellow Couch Tour in Provo on Wednesday afternoon.
|
---
Getting ready for golden hour with supporters in Midway Wednesday evening.
| This is my **favorite part** of being on the **campaign trail.**

This election isn't about me, nor about Mike Lee. **It's about you.**

Election day, June 28th, will be here in the **blink of an eye,** but for the next 11 days, I'm going around the state to hear your story, your concerns, and **your vision for Utah's future.**

It's **why I'm in this race,** and I'm eager to**take your story with me** to Washington D.C.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| **Looking for a chance to connect?** I was hoping you were. Join me **this weekend** at one of our next events!
---
| |
## **Friday**
**Bountiful Rotary Car Show, 6:00-9:00 pm,[ 200 South Main Street, Bountiful](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=5e79c01c68&e=10c1db3257)**
## **Saturday**
**Midway Yellow Couch Tour, 10:00-11:30 am,[ 160 S Center St., Midway](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=af5141c6c6&e=10c1db3257)

Ogden Juneteenth Heritage Festival, 1:30-2:30 pm, [Taggart Student Center, Utah State University](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=7b3b1221f7&e=10c1db3257)

Ogden Yellow Couch Tour, 3:00-5:00 pm, [4245 Skyline Pkwy, Ogden](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=a53475c9a0&e=10c1db3257)**
---
| Ballots were mailed to every **registered Republican voter** on June 7th. Already, voters across the state have **flooded our social media** with photos of their ballots and [#bubblesforbecky](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=51f10e0fcd&e=10c1db3257).

I am thrilled to see **so many Utahns** getting involved, filling out their ballots, and **spreading the word** on how to**participate in this month's primary! **

As we've been sharing information on **how, when, and where** to vote, Utahns have been reaching out with **questions about their mail-in ballots.**

So, **if you haven't received your ballot** but were expecting one, don't worry—**you're not alone!** There are a **few reasons** you could be missing your ballot, but rest assured, **you can still make your voice heard in this month's primary!** Here's what you need to know:
## **It's not too late to vote by mail!**
If you're a **registered Republican,** the deadline to **request a mail-in ballot** is Tuesday, **June 21st,** by 5 pm. To request a mail ballot, contact your county clerk's office! You can **find your county clerk's contact and county mail election information** [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=ed18371fd6&e=10c1db3257).
## **Double-check your voter registration at[vote.utah.gov](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=196c1ad710&e=10c1db3257).**
You can use the **'Find my voter registration'** tool to see your information. Once you have your information, **there are a few things to look for:**
---
| |
## **Are you registered as a Republican?**
If you are a **new or unaffiliated voter,** the deadline to **affiliate online** is TODAY! Head to [vote.utah.gov](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=6ae7c5cff0&e=10c1db3257) to **register or update** your voter information.

To **register or affiliate in person,** bring **two forms** of identification to your polling location by election day, June 28th. Learn more about **Utah's voter I.D. requirements** [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=44fd682a73&e=10c1db3257).
---
| |
## **What's your voter status?**
If your voter status is active, but you **didn't receive your ballot,** contact your county clerk's office**as soon as possible.

Inactive voters**—voters who have not voted in **two regular general elections** and have not responded to a notice from their county clerk—**do not receive mail ballots.**

If your voter status is listed as inactive, but **you want to vote by mail,** contact your county clerk's office to **update your status and request your mail ballot** by Tuesday, **June 21st** at 5 pm. Inactive voters can **vote early and on election day** **in person.** Find your county's**early voting dates and polling locations**[**** here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=10c22d5fa1&e=10c1db3257).
---
| |
## **Do you have the correct mailing address?**
If you've**moved** or your mailing address **differs from your residential address,** you can update your mailing information [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=21dec812cf&e=10c1db3257). Once your information is **up to date,** contact your county clerk's office to **request your mail ballot** by Tuesday, **June 21st** at 5 pm!
---
| **Still unsure about how to participate in this month's primary?** We've got you covered! Contact us on **social media** **at @beckyforutah** **or email at info@beckyforutah.com** so we can help you **get to the polls** this month!
---
|
