body:
Thank you for your generous support of Tom's campaign! Keep reading for a recap of his time on the campaign trail, an update on upcoming events, and ways to get involved.
#

**Team Tom Weekly Update | Friday, June 17th, 2022**
Peter,
This week our team was proud to be with United States Speaker of the House — and Baltimore's own —Nancy Pelosi, as she expressed the strong urgency to elect Tom Perez and Shannon Sneed as Maryland’s next Governor and Lieutenant Governor.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657857/351195648/224972089?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
With mail in ballots officially being delivered, and election day near 30 days away, we are confident that the **#momenTOM** is on our side. Thanks to your continued support, we will achieve our vision of expanding jobs, justice, and opportunity to all Marylanders.
All the best,
Team Tom
* * *
**On the Campaign Trail**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657858/351195649/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657859/351195650/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Tom and Shannon kicked off last Saturday with our friends from CASA in Action, SEIU32BJ and SEIU500, UFCW, and AFSCME for an energizing afternoon in Langley Park.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657860/351195651/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
On Saturday afternoon, CASA in Action members made over 10,000 phone calls in support of Tom Perez and Shannon Sneed for Governor and Lieutenant Governor!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657861/351195652/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657862/351195653/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Tom and his wife, Ann Marie, were proud to volunteer this weekend at[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657863/351195654/-427417752?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)Shepherd’s Table, an amazing organization helping address food insecurity, homelessness, and poverty in the heart of Silver Spring.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46657864/351195655/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODY3ZDFiNC04N2VlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wrB6LxyhBputbx7kWLZdB4SWXj6hcTaaJuKScY1FIv8=&emci=8d2929bb-45ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2867d1b4-87ee-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
We are so grateful for our growing coalition of support. Our team had a great time Sunday gathering with friends and supporters at our live music event right in Tom’s neighborhood of Takoma Park.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Inflation 📈
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
What’s happening isn’t just random. It’s plain wrong.
#
Hi Derek, it’s John.
In PA + across the country, people are getting squeezed, Derek. We’re paying more at the grocery store, more at the pump, and more almost everywhere. 📈📈📈
Of course, my opponent, millionaire celebrity Mehmet Oz, doesn’t feel a change in price when he’s filling up his gas tank, if he even pumps his own gas at all (they don’t let you do that in Oz’s native New Jersey). He doesn’t have to worry about his gas or grocery bill, and doesn’t even notice if it’s more than it used to be.
When I fill up my Dodge RAM, it’s costing a *hell* of a lot more than it did a year ago.
When Gisele + I go shopping for groceries at Giant Eagle, almost everything we buy costs more.
So many families are dealing with this. In May, the Consumer Price Index saw the largest jump in consumer prices in 41 years, with inflation at 8.6% compared to the previous year. Inflation is hitting families across the commonwealth.
**But what’s happening isn’t just random. It’s plain wrong.**
Let’s talk about gas prices. Just last week, gas prices hit a record high of $5.07 per gallon in Pennsylvania, an outrageously high price that is impacting families across Pennsylvania.
But the truth is, if it wasn’t for the greed of oil companies, prices likely wouldn’t be this high.
This past week, crude oil was going for around $120 a barrel — the highest price we've seen since mid-2014. But back then, a gallon of gas only cost about $3.50.
**Oil companies don’t need to be charging this much for gas — they’re just doing it to make excess profits.** 💰💰💰
While people across Pennsylvania are paying more than $5 a gallon for gas, companies such as Shell, Chevron, BP and ExxonMobil are all raking in record-breaking profits, lining their CEOs’ and shareholders’ pockets. In just the first three months of 2022, 28 of the largest oil and gas producers made over $100 billion in profits.
It’s hard to even _conceptualize_ how much money that is.
But don’t just take it from me, take it from the companies themselves. Chevron says the company is “generating excess cash”; Exxon says it’s getting an “advantage from the market”; and BP says that the rising price of oil is helping its bottom line.
What does that actually look like? In the past year, Exxon’s profits doubled; Shell’s tripled; and Chevron’s quadrupled.
_That’s_ what I mean by record profits.
It’s gross, and *deeply* unpatriotic, for the big oil companies to be rolling around in cash while charging us $5 per gallon for gas.
Instead of raising costs at the pump, these oil companies should be working to help drive prices down, even if it means their CEOs make a little bit less. Or — God forbid — just make the same millions of dollars as they made last year. 🙄
And if we’re going to be serious about bringing down gas prices, we need to suspend the federal gas tax to provide immediate relief for people at the pump. We should also continue to use American oil — and produce and invest in more American energy.
But inflation isn’t only impacting us at the pump. **It’s everywhere**. So it’s not just energy we should be making here at home. **It’s everything.**
More American energy, more American manufacturing, more American goods, and more American jobs. 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸
We should be ramping up production across industries, increasing capacity + supply to bring down prices across the board.
Making more stuff here in America would mean prices wouldn’t spike every time there’s a problem overseas. We don’t need to be outsourcing any more jobs + production to China. and we don’t need to be shouldering the burden when other countries enter into conflicts or declare deranged wars, such as Russia’s Vladimir Putin did in Ukraine, which contributed to prices skyrocketing.
We can use American energy to drive down prices at the gas pump for American workers, and we can use American workers to drive down the price of everything, for everyone.
This isn’t a radical proposal. **It’s basic common sense.**
Pennsylvania’s workers can compete with anyone in the world. We can do it all right here: drive down prices, create good-paying union jobs, and finally stop our dependence on foreign sources of energy and production.
But here’s the catch, Derek:**To get these common-sense solutions, we need real leaders who get it.** And let’s be clear: Mehmet Oz is not connected to the struggles that Pennsylvanians are facing every day. He’s a millionaire television doctor who is a resident of New Jersey. While paying an extra $10, $20 or $30 for gas means nothing to him, it matters to the rest of us.
Pennsylvania deserves better. We deserve a senator who actually gets it, a real Pennsylvanian who understands the pain that families are feeling across this commonwealth.
We need real solutions — not a celebrity vanity project — because right now, Pennsylvania families can’t afford anything less.
[**_Derek, make a donation of any amount today to help defeat Dr. Oz and send me to the U.S. Senate. Your donation comes with a promise: I will fight like *hell* for you + your family — and that includes bringing down sky-high prices._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220617-2?refcode=em20220617-6240&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6240_434096_YKUsXm&akid=6240%2E434096%2EYKUsXm)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220617-2?refcode=em20220617-6240&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6240_434096_YKUsXm&akid=6240%2E434096%2EYKUsXm)**
Thanks,
John

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220617-6240-footer&t=1&refcode2=6240_434096_YKUsXm&akid=6240%2E434096%2EYKUsXm)**

| | [Team, this election, things are going to be tough.

With Republicans bringing in more and more money, we have got to keep pace for the sake of abortion rights, voting rights, privacy rights, and our democracy as a whole. House Majority PAC has seen donations come in from all across the country and all walks of life.

subject: Yesterday my team reached out about our work to protect voting access

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

One of the most destructive effects of voter suppression is that beyond
making it difficult or impossible for some voters to cast a ballot, it
convinces others to not bother trying. They may think to themselves, “Why
bother?”

To that, I say, we vote because we must. It’s more important than ever
that every eligible voter steps up and makes their voice heard. That’s how
we can move forward and support all Georgians.

We need Georgia voters to know that there are resources and a grassroots
team behind them now working to ensure they can exercise their fundamental
right to vote. That’s why my campaign is committed to helping voters
overcome any obstacle the GOP may put in front of the ballot box.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1456?refcode=sa_em_220617_B2_VotingRights_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=666%2E1862389%2EoycwTn ]This is vital work, and I’m counting on grassroots
supporters to make
sure we’re able to fight back against Republican voter suppression here in
Georgia. Can I count on you to make a donation to help protect voting
rights, win this election and get to work for Georgians?

We need you to think about this clearly: we are going to be up against
ruthless and relentless efforts to suppress the vote every day between now
and November. High turnout does not mean our work is done. It simply
proves defeating suppression is possible. Our campaign has a plan to help
ensure every voter’s voice is heard — but it is a plan that relies on
investment, time and attention.

We know what it takes to win in Georgia. Our historic Senate victories
last year were the result of a decade of organizing and faith in our
communities — and the efforts of grassroots
supporters like you.
But the challenge in front of us is to make sure last year’s victories
were more than just anomalies.

That’s where you come in,
Derek. Our voter protection
program is a fundamental component of our strategy to win this November,
and it relies on grassroots supporters like you.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1456?refcode=sa_em_220617_B2_VotingRights_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=666%2E1862389%2EoycwTn ]I’m asking because it is vital: will you make a $5
donation today? Anything you can give helps make sure we have the
resources to fight back against Brian Kemp’s voter suppression and win.

I’m so grateful you are on this team.

Thank you,

Stacey Abrams

| | Este mes de junio nos dedicamos a celebrar las libertades que hemos conseguido. Es algo absurdo en muchos niveles porque la Constitución trata a todos por igual. Son las actitudes y acciones de la gente contra las que luchamos. Este es el primer año en que el 19 de junio se reconoce como fiesta nacional (Juneteenth) y lo celebramos. Junio es el mes del PRIDE y lo celebramos. Pero, y lamentablemente siempre hay un pero, nuestra celebración se ve afectada este año por los ataques agresivos de aquellos que se sienten amenazados por el concepto de protección igualitaria y libertad para todos. Ya sea el "no digas gay", o la negación del racismo institucionalizado, o el tratar a los trabajadores como siervos, o el rechazar el derecho de la mujer a la autonomía sobre su cuerpo, o el creer que los derechos de portar un arma de fuego descuidadamente es más importante que el derecho de un niño a vivir. Mientras haya personas que nos miren como si fuéramos "aquellos", tendremos que estar atentos y mantenernos firmes. Espero que sus celebraciones de este mes estén llenas de grandes alegrías y promesas. \- Doug
---
| This month of June we take time to celebrate the freedoms we have won. This is absurd on many levels because the Constitution treats all equal. It is the attitudes and actions of people that we struggle against. This is the first year that Juneteenth is recognized as a national holiday and we celebrate. June is PRIDE month and we celebrate. But, and there is sadly always a but, our celebration is tempered this year with aggressive attacks by those that feel threatened by concept of equal protection and freedom for all. Whether it is "don't say gay", denial of institutionalized racism, treating workers like indentured servants, rejecting a woman's right to autonomy over her body, or believing that those unfit to own firearm rights are more important than a child's right to live. As long as there are people that look at us and see "them" we will need to be vigilant and stand fast. I hope your celebrations this month are filled with great joy and promise. -Doug
---
| | |
---
| | El orgullo continúa. ¡Únete a nosotros este sábado 18 de Junio para el PRIDE festival de Yakima! Después del enorme y maravilloso PRIDE del fin de semana anterior en Tri-Cities, Yakima sigue con su desfile. Un gran saludo a Wenatchee ya que celebran su PRIDE mañana también. ¡Asegúrese de pasar por mi puesto y decir hola! PRIDE continues. Join us this Saturday, June 18th for Yakima PRIDE! After last weekend's huge and wonderful PRIDE in the Tri-Cities Yakima is following up with a parade! Give a big shout-out to Wenatchee as they celebrate their pride tomorrow also. Be sure and show up at my booth and say hello!
---
| |
---

Doug y los aspirantes republicanos en el almuerzo de la Cámara de Comercio.

| | Este año, el 19 de junio (Juneteenth) ha sido reconocido como fiesta nacional por primera vez. | Brno Brigade,
We are less 50 than days away from the Arizona Senate Primary! It's time to push the gas and get Mark across the finish line so he can take on Mark Kelly. The campaign is looking for supporters to open up their home and host Mark Brnovich! Invite 20-30 of your friends, family, or neighbors to meet the next Senator from Arizona. Ask questions, talk about the important issues of the day, and find out how Mark Brnovich will fight for you in Washington.

[Email Mitch if you want to host! ](mailto:mitch@brnoforaz.com)Thank you for being a key member of the #BrnoBrigade. We couldn't do it without you!

If you are interested or have further questions about hosting a meet and greet, please do not hesitate to reach out.
---
| [ ](mailto:mitch@brnoforaz.com)
---
| GET INVOLVED: The Brno Brigade is a rapidly growing team of grassroots activists who are committed to ensuring that we can flip the Senate back to a Republican majority. We are always looking for patriotic Arizonans who want to take action in all corners of the state. Here are a few ways that you can directly help:
1. **Make phone calls** – contacting Arizonans is critical to our statewide operation and outreach efforts. These are the easiest way to ensure that voters in every county are aware of Brnovich’s proven conservative record and why he’s the best candidate to uphold Arizona values as a Senator!
2. **Knock doors in your neighborhood** – door-to-door canvassing is the most effective way to help us turn out the vote and spread our winning message. Face-to-face conversations are ultimately the ones that are the most impactful.
3. **Amplify our efforts** – be sure to follow the Brnovich campaign accounts on social media and include #BrnoBrigade in any posts!
4. **Place a yard sign** – this is a great way of expressing your support at the most localized level – your yard! If you have any friends/family/neighbors that also want one, they can request a sign here or by contacting us directly.

If you would like a volunteer training, please respond to this email or contact Mitch Ferrari, Political Director at mitch@brnoforaz.com or (480) 269-5785
